name: Gregor Ogen
text: My favorite restaurant in Richmond and consistently exceeding expectations. One of my favorite things is they change up the menu a good amount. It's easy to stick with one menu of great staples, but I love trying out new things. It's risky and may not alway work, but so often it does work and anyone who truly loves food would appreciate it.

name: Hannah Tucker
text: Probably one of the best restaurants I've been to. The food was incredible, the drinks were so unique and tasty. I loved the steak frites. The service was incredible as well. I will definitely be back.

name: Robin Lotz
text:

I will dine in soon

name: Callista Rogers
text:
The menu looks small, but the options for the charcuterie are enough to make your night your own. Once you've ordered the smorgasbord, I have to recommend the duck confit. The duck meat is a beautiful beet red color and melts in your mouth. The skin is perfectly crispy. And then for dessert, you can't go wrong with proliferats. Eclair like pastries hold a delicious vanilla ice cream with a hot chocolate sauce poured over. It's perfection.
And the outside tents make it safer during covid times. remember your mask when your server comes by, and otherwise it almost feels normal again.

name: Danielle Kirrane
text: My boyfriend and I went to Grisette tonight for dinner & it did not disappoint. The options were diverse, wine selection was wide, decor was cozy & charming. We had a lovely time. Make a reservation & support this DELICIOUS small biz!

name: Amanda Jewsbury
text: I can’t say enough good things about this place

name: TIFFANY HITAFFER
text: Such a great neighborhood restaurant. They're doing their part during the epidemic to provide for the community and the food is awesome! Can't wait to dine in again!

name: Katie Adcock
text: Very cozy setting. Great cocktail choices. On Monday evening they offer a prix fix meal (I didn't get it, but a few in my party did, and it was a great deal). I was a little disappointed that the only salad option on the regular menu wound up being $7 for literally just butter lettuce covered in grated parmesan cheese and a vinaigrette. Maybe it felt disappointing because the prix fix salad looked much nicer (even if it was a tad smaller, there was more to it than lettuce, cheese, and dressing), though I can't complain about the taste. I had the steak tartare for my entree and it was satisfyingly delicious. Then my friends who had the prix fix meal had their dessert delivered to them yet the waiter hadn't asked anyone else in the party if we wanted dessert, and the prix fix dessert hadn't been described. I'm glad I hadn't gotten the prix fix meal as the dessert had shaved coconut,  and I'm not a big fan of that though a taste was very good, but I did have the chocolate mousse dessert, and that was divine. I could have eaten an entire bowl. Overall I'd give this place 4.5 stars, and if I lived closer, I would go back again some time.

name: Bree Booth
text: Accessibly chic, Grisette was a perfect way to enter back into in-restaurant dining. Covid protocols made me feel comfortable while enjoying some perfectly crispy-soft fries with aoili, two varieties of balanced & fresh glasses of white wine, and the most options I've ever seen available for a charcuterie board. We selected three meats and cheeses, in addition to the pickled veggies and perfectly textured bread that comes with it. We ended the meal with a fresh peach galette- crispy pastry, tarragon (!) on the peaches, and vanilla bean ice cream. I don't regret a single sip or bite of this amazing meal! Fantastic first time experience- thank you!

name: Emily Beacham
text: Had an earlyish dinner here a couple weeks ago really was impressed. The atmosphere is very cool, clean and chic yet small and cozy. All of the dining plates are unique, which I found really delightful. The staff gave us great recommendations and the menu worked for a variety of diet restrictions (vegetarian for me, and hearty meaty dishes for my partner). A lot of ingredients seemed to be locally sourced as well. Prices were really reasonable for the quality of food.  The restaurant isn't huge and they don't have many large tables, so call ahead, go early or go prepared to enjoy a drink at the bar if you do have to wait. Great for fancier date nights out or just damn good food on a weeknight.

name: Will Hayes
text: Lively new spot in Richmond with excellent food. The atmosphere is cozy and inventive. At first I was taken aback by the small menu but in the end appreciated its precision. I got the Steak Frites and would not hesitate to get them again.

resp.text: Thank you!

text: Good service. Interesting menu. Fun drink menu. Very loud inside. We managed to only stay for drinks before heading out to eat somewhere we could hear our conversation.

resp.text:
Hey Ian!  Thanks for stopping by.  We're working on some sound dampening.  We knew it would be a little noisy, but you're totally right, it's just too loud.  Should be installed shortly.  Hope to see you again soon!

UPDATE- sound dampening panels are installed!  We also added a subwoofer to the audio system to help disperse some bass that was coming from above.  We've been poppin' the last couple nights and it's made a huge difference.  Come have a listen!

text: It was very busy when we arrived.  At least 45 minute wait. As we waited she brought us a menu to go over. The place was packed but they treated us as though we were the only ones there. In short time someone came to us as we were standing by the door and took our drink orders. Then the chef came to talk to us to make sure we were happy 😊.  I mean who does that.... After a short time we were seated. The drinks were excellent 👍. Service great and the food was delicious.  If this keeps up Richmond restaurants will be eating Grisette's dust for a long time.

resp.text: Thanks Dan!!!! Can't wait to see you again soon!

text: Checked this place out on a Monday night for the 22$ special. Food was top notch and so were the cocktails. This place kinda has it all, location,  ambience, service and great quality food and drinks.  Highly recommended!

resp.text: Thank you Nemer!

name: Kathy Butler
text: Ups and downs. Cocktails were good. Weird to be served sparkling rose in a run of the mill wine glass though. Oysters were completely overwhelmed by the duck fat bread crumbs. While tasty, the pot pie was actually a bowl of soup with a very good piece of puff pastry laid on top. The risotto had a weird taste in the demi glace that covered everything else up, but the lamb on top was the absolute best thing we had. Super flavorful and moist. Daily dessert of citrus cake was much too dense and not light and fresh tasting. Overall, a disappointing meal.

resp.text:
Hey Kathy-
Thanks for the feedback.  If you'd give us a shout at grisetterva@gmail.com, I'd love to chat briefly and identify why your experience fell short of most every one else's.  I'd love to know what was "weird" about the demi, talk about our wine by the glass stemware choice, etc.  Honest conversation helps everyone!  Hopefully talk soon!

name: Richard Borean
text: Such a great addition to Church Hill's already excellent restaurant scene. An exciting and expertly crafted charcuterie/cheese selection; a tightly focused menu with fresh ingredients, unique and balanced flavors, correct portion sizes, and moderate pricing;  a refreshing and truly interesting libations menu; and a beautiful, comfortable atmosphere that invokes the idyllic Richmond night life balance of energy and hominess make for a wonderful dining experience that I cannot wait to try again. Our waitress was phenomenal. She knew everything about the menu, paced the meal perfectly, was genuinely warm, and knew how to manage a table. It is shocking that they've only been open a week and are already delivering a service at this level. If you are like me and have been waiting for 2 years for this place to open, then give it a shot. You won't be disappointed.  The owners have come through on all their promises and will fit in perfectly in the neighborhood.

text: It took me a while to decide if this place deserved 4 or 5 stars.  Let me break it down like this.  As for the food and the wait staff, easily 5 stars without a doubt.  Cleanliness, 5 stars.  But, what caused such a great sounding place to lose a star from my personal review?  Parking and price...let me explain.  This place is so good that even the locals choose to eat there.  Add to this the tourists and you will have to wait a while to get a seat.  For the food, the wait is worth it.  Therefore, you will likely find parking a bit difficult, especially for an out-of-towner.  Again, it is worth the trouble.  However, it seems that this place is trying to make this place a bit more exclusive by charging prices that are higher than similar sit down breakfast dining restaurants.  Don't get me wrong, everything was excellent.  But, with the higher cost and parking difficulty, I just couldn't give that fifth star.  Let me leave it like this...will I go back?  Without a doubt!

name: thomas braden
text:
Terrible customer service. Good fresh food.

Stopped here off I95 and waited FOREVER for anyone to greet us or heaven forbid take our order or even speak to us... nothing.

So we decided we had better use the kiosk, of the three only one was functioning.

Placed our Togo order for lunch 3 adults and 1 kid, none of us familiar w the kiosk etc and it takes forever. By this time a young gal has stepped from the back and started to take face to face orders (for two local families).

Anyway, my steak sandwich has nothing on it - no lettuce not tomato? And my son’s bagel is not sliced nor toasted nor does it have cream cheese on it or in the bag... and this was the hardest part of using the kiosk, finding where we selected slice, toast and add cream cheese - which of course is an up-charge?!

I’d like my money back. I look forward to hearing from management.

Cafe order # 553463100 04/05/21 at 1242 pm

That’s the best that I can do, as the kiosk didn’t give me a receipt.

name: David Aherron
text: Not a good start... This Panera has been open for a few weeks now and today was my first visit. name: Cody Rowe
text:
Judging by how good the Newport News Red Lobster has become we decided to go here since it is closer to home.

I went for lunch with my family and my parents and was very disappointed in the service.  There was no one at the front desk, and no employees in sight.  Instead of waiting to be seated I just went and found my parents and sat with them.  After quite a while of waiting with no one in sight, I finally had mine and my family's drink order taken.  1 beer, a coke, and a sweet tea took roughly 7-10 minutes or so.  We were 1 of 2 tables in the entire place at this point.  Finally got our drinks and ordered our food and was asked if we wanted our salads now.  We said yes.  Salads wound up coming out about 2 minutes before the entrée came out.  It was quite a long wait for a minimal salad considering there was virtually no one there.  I sat there with an empty drink for quite a while during my meal.  Once I got my second drink, a 3rd beer was brought out that I had not ordered.  It was then brought back a second time asking if it was mine...which it wasn't.  By now there were 4 or 5 tables.  And then another time they came back with the beer again and it was NOT mine.  I had literally just gotten mine right before they came up with the other one.  How many times do I have to say I already got the one I ordered?  Then to top it off, they had a charge on our meal for something we never ordered.  The guy that seemed to be the lead in charge promptly took it off the order and was very nice(kudos to him as he was the ONLY bright spot on the staff.)
The food wasn't the best I have had at red lobster but it was still pretty good.  A little on the greasy side compared to what I have had at other locations, but I love seafood.  Everything was cooked well...just a little greasy but that is being kind of picky.
Overall this rating is more about the very poor service we received after spending way too long having a lunch and sitting with empty drinks while waiting for our food for seemingly forever.
I realize that lunch staff is going to have less employees than dinner, but it was a Saturday.  There should be someone on the floor SOMEWHERE in the restaurant.  I don't see how you can get away with having no one in sight on a weekend.  If I get another gift card or decide to go to Red Lobster again, I will likely spend the extra 20 minutes to drive to Newport News.  Very disappointed with this establishment after seeing how much better Newport News has gotten.
I hate leaving negative reviews, but this warranted one.  The only reason it is 2 stars instead of one is that the lead came out, was super nice, and fixed the mess-ups on our bill.

She usually loves the scampi but said something was different this time But she couldn't figure out what. She said it was good but not as good as it usually is. My Dragon Shrimp was delicious. I love the spiciness of the dish and wish I could recreate it at home. The shrimp was freshly cooked and crispy, the broccoli perfectly cooked crisp-tender and a beautiful bright green. The rice-quinoa mix was also delicious. text: We came for my friend's birthday party.  Our server was the highlight of the evening, although the food was definitely perfect and the portions were very large. She called us 'doll' and 'boo' and went out of her way to do any request we had.  She kept us laughing with funny jokes and she stood high on a chair to get a picture of us from an aerial angle.  She was the best!  She also brought us extra hot dinner rolls and we were so stuffed we hardly had room for birthday cake!  Thank you to Red Lobster for making my friend's birthday so memorable and special.  We will be back in the future!  By the way, the lobster bisque and clam chowder were the best soups I have ever tasted.

5-star service drove the rating on this review. The cheddar bay biscuits are still the awesomest. The seafood stuffed mushroom appetizer (pictured) was so good - the picture doesn't do it justice. The bahama mamas (frozen version) were really good! I had a caesar salad (meh/average), we split a bowl of lobster bisque (very good, the lobster meat in it was super perfect), then the meals were pretty great!

I had a 6oz filet, the harvest roasted vegetables, and the lobster-and-cheesesauce covered mashed potatoes (though they call this by a fancier name now). The filet was a little thinner than expected, but still good. The vegetables could have been roasted just a tiny bit longer, but had awesome flavor. The potatoes were just okay, BUT the cheese sauce and lobster meat on them was great.

She had the tuna poke and the dragon broccoli, and was happy with how tasty they both were. Overall a great experience. We'll do this again!

name: Michael Valdivielso
text:
It was my birthday on May 19th.  Me and my Mom decided to go to Red Lobster for dinner.  The staff was nice and the restaurant was clean and not that busy.  We had gone to this location before many times over the years and I can say it has improved over the time period.  It use to be all walls and darkness.  But they had knocked the walls down and the place felt a lot more cheerful with all the natural light.
The staff was friendly and quick.  My Mom ordered the Dragon Shrimp and I ordered half a Cajun Salmon which came with shrimp and two sides.  We also both got salads with our entrees.  To be honest I didn't notice that on the menu and was pleased about that.
My Mom also told the waiter it was my birthday.  And to be honest I cringed.  I don't like the whole birthday song thing some places do.
The salad came first, then the cheesy biscuits, and then out entrees.  All timed out very well.  And then, after we were finished, the waiter brought me two scoops of ice cream with whipped cream and a cherry on top.  Which I enjoyed.  No song.
It was all very delightful and the one time I was able to get my Mom to agree to a higher tip than just 15%.
I would also like to add that the table next to us had a party of four.  And once they left one of the staff came over to clean up.  But he just didn't clean the table.  He MOVED the table out of the booth so he could properly get at the floor and seat covers.  One advantage of removing the walls.  Well beyond what I might normally see at a Red Lobster.  OR any other family restaurant I have visited.
In other words, great food, great and friendly service, and well worth the visit.

resp.text: Thanks for sharing the love, hope to welcome you back soon, Michael!

name: Ciara Long
text: New to the area and had been referred to Baddpizza multiple times being from NY (914). I wouldn’t say NY pizza (never had Buffalo pizza so it may be that) but it was pretty good. The wings were perfect though and the customer service was phenomenal even late at night as the cashier offered to carry out my order when he noticed I was pregnant.

name: Andy Kujawa
text: This place was awesome! The food is LEGIT and tastes just like being back in the 716. The wings were cooked and sauced perfectly and the pizza was dialed in. My daughter even said that it's better than mine and this is her new favorite pizza. My son gave it the Buffalo seal of approval as well. If you're a Buffalonian, you have to get here.

name: Glenn Montague
text: Their pizza is actually better after it is reheated. Otherwise, the crust is bready, and the tomato sauce tastes like it has been sweetened.

name: Real BBQ Dude
text: Badd Pizza is phenomenal!!! The pizza is out of this world. It has a nice crispy crust with a chewy inside. The sauce is great and the cheese is bubbly and melty. Whatever you do  Get the pepperoni's as a topping. They are cupped and charred and add a crispy crunch to each bite.  We got a meat lovers and a white pizza, both of which were amazing. But the unsung hero was  the BBQ Pit Wings. It should not be a surprise because Badd is buffalo style pizza and wings.  We got a side of medium  sauce to drizzle on top. They came out perfectly crispy. Perhaps the best wings I have ever had. It is a bit pricey for wings and pizza but it was delicious! The dining room is a bit plain and echoey but it is fine. The restaurant is located in a strip center so parking is fine. There is a gym next door so it may be hard to find a close spot depending on when you go. The food is great and worth a trip!

name: Paul W
text: My family Loves the pizza here and the wings are Fantastic. True Buffalo style Pizza and wings. Two thumbs up for sure!

name: C J
text:
I was appalled at the service I've experienced & received at the South Riding Badd Pizza location.   I honestly don't know where to begin or end so I'm going to keep it short, I just know that I have to make my South Riding community aware.

My order was not ready & available at the time designated for pick up,  VERY long wait,  was there for an additional 30 mins.

I got home to find out that part of my order was wrong & in addition wasn't edible,  the food was not cooked properly.   I arrived back at the location to return the undercooked/wrong food & to obtain a refund.   I was denied a refund, the young lady mocked me & debated with me for at least 20 mins before she finally gave me a refund.  She stated she couldn't give me the refund because she didn't believe anything was wrong with the food though I advised her on the discrepancies.  I really hope no one else in my community experiences this type of service & embarrassment.   I'll never return.

Best

name: B H
text:
I just walked in and ordered around 2:30 or so on a random Tuesday. I was excited to try the pizza and wings that I had been hearing so much about in the community. First person I ran into was Keith and we struck up a good conversation as there wasn’t anyone else in their. Steve quickly joined the conversation and the three of us chatted for the entire time my food was being prepared. Both are awesome guys!

The hot wings were the perfect combination of sauce with flavor and a little kick and were also crispy! Best wings I’ve ever had to be honest!

The pizza was great with fresh toppings, edge to edge toppings, flavorful and crispy crust and for a half pizza was much larger than I was expecting.

Excellent place to now get my pizza and wings. The community has needed a breath of fresh air for a while in this department. You won’t be disappointed!

name: Danielle Crowley
text: Great pizza and wings. I'm from Buffalo and I've stopped eating pizza from anywhere in NOVA because it's always terrible. This pizza is exactly like it should be, good crust, sauce, cheese, and the pepperoni!!! Wings were crispy and delicious. Great job guys, my fiance and I are super excited to actually be able to order pizza and wings again! Only downfall is it's a bit on the pricey side, but it's worth it.

text: This is the best pizza in Northern Virginia hands down. I’m a native of Buffalo, NY and this style of pizza is every bit as good as what you’ll get there. Along with the pizza the chicken tenders are amazing as well. Can’t wait to try everything on the menu 👍🏻

name: Terry Donaldson
text:
Finally got a chance to stop in and grab a bite of some southern cookin' for dinner.  Once I saw that Chicken Fried Steak and Fried Okra were on the menu... I knew I was all set.  Sad that the mac n' cheese was out, but Mashed Potatoes (not instant as one reviewer here stated) with gravy rounded out my "carb heavy" meal.  Lol.   The food was very good and "just enough" if you are hungry.  The waitress was friendly and never had to wait for a refill or extra napkins.   Reasonable prices.  Will be back to try some breakfast dishes because any other meal there (as folks who know me and southern cookin' can attest to) will be Country Fried Steak and Fried Okra. 😁

Please note that the ONLY reason I did not give a 5 Star is because I have only been here ONCE.  Consistency will earn the last one. 👍

name: Marc Cascio
text:
Our family has a time honored tradition: during the holiday season, when we are shelling out money hand over fist, a major appliance breaks. This year  it was our garbage disposal, so we had to order out for dinner despite my tightwad tendencies.
We wanted pizza, but we wanted a break from the typical delivery service pies.  Having lived in Chantilly and worked at Chantilly High School  I remebered Tony's vividly. So we ordered to large pies, and I ventured out from Burke to retrieve them.
The first thing I noticed was that the boxes weren't saturated with grease- a real difference from even the brick oven joints much closer by.
Then, when we opened the boxes and dug in  the slices didn't flop over like a flimsy Shakespeare with Jaws on the other end. They stayed rigid  , like those slices might should they be privy to a certain little pill.
And the taste? Phenomenal! The ingredients were fresh, it wasn't an oversauced fiasco, and the cheese didn't slough off when you pulled out a slice.
We will be back to Tony's despite the longish ride. If you don't like it, Va Fan Gool

text:
$38 for a good sub, below average pizza, & mozzarella sticks served with tomato soup sauce???? What is this?

The steak & cheese was the best part of the meal! I’ll give 2 thumbs up for that!

The pizza was well below average! For the price you’re better off going to Mellow Mushroom or another pizza joint. It seems like someone went to subway, grabbed two day old ingredients & threw them on a pepperoni pizza.

The mozzarella sticks & “marinara sauce” (Campbell’s tomato soup).. was hands down the worst appetizer I’ve ever had & that says a lot.

Extremely expensive for less than mediocre food.

resp.text: Hi Zach, we don't use any tomato soup as our sauce. We hand make all of our sauce using top quality imported italian tomatoes. We don't add any spices or unnecessary things because we believe in traditional italian style of cooking where you taste the quality of ingredients. Some people don't like that but we don't like to mask the taste of high quality ingredients with "extras". That has been our tradition for 25 years here and many years before that at home.

Manager said the kitchen staff  just refused to make it.   Got our money back but never were served.   Finally went back a couple weeks ago.   Again,  no service.   Complained and finally got our subs.  The veal parm was disgusting,  like shoe leather.   The Italian sub had one thin slice of ham and one thin slice of salami.   Could barely see the meat and could not taste it.  Horrible.   Never again.

resp.text:
Sorry you didn't have a good experience, Richard. Maybe come back and try another item off our menu. No plans to close anytime soon. Pretty harsh comment to leave, wish you would leave more detail.

Richard, Thank you for editing your response and providing more detail. This seems very uncharacteristic of our staff, this is the first time I've heard of something like this happening. I am going to address this with my team today. I hope this is not a confusion of how we serve our food. We do serve food as it is prepared and some items, like slices or salads for example, typically come out of the kitchen much quicker than subs or entrees. If the team did not explain that to you that is a failure on our end. But again I do appreciate you providing more detail with your review the second time around as we are always working to improve.

name: Jonathan Esten
text:
Thin crust perfection. Of the half-dozen places to get pizza in Fair Lakes, Tony's is definitely my favorite.

I'm not one to say "no" to a crust with a little crisp on the bottom, a good chew, and thin enough to fold your slice for a big ol' two-layer bite. Tony's makes their crust right, and tops it with a tomato sauce that's just a little sweet, just a little herby. A layer of quality cheese, and you've got my order. Don't get me wrong, the pie is a great base for your favorite toppings, but a well made thin crust cheese pizza is so satisfying and surprisingly hard to find.

Still in pizza land, when i want to go a little different the four-cheese white pizza is a garlic lover's dream. The Margarita Special with salty prosciutto is indeed special.

I've also really enjoyed the gnocchi, but I can't bring myself to turn down the pizza often enough to say I've tried much else on the menu.

This is seriously good pizza, and I'm serious about pizza. Get a large, because even the leftovers are better than a lot of the options out there.

text: Google maps has the menu items listed incorrectly. Apparently the prices are much greater than advertised. For example, we came because Google maps showed the menu price of a 16 inch cheese pizza as $12. What a deal, right!? When we ordered, they said those are not valid prices and instead charge $13.95 for a cheese pizza.

resp.text: James, thank you for the review. I've just double checked and you are correct, the menu feature when viewed from a mobile device is displaying the incorrect pricing. I had changed the menu link of the goggle page to direct customers to our website a while ago but it seems they have not yet updated this portion. I'll work on getting that updated right away. Our website does indicate that a large New York style cheese pizza is $13.95. A $16 subtotal likely resulted if you ordered additional toppings. Sorry for the technical mix up but I hope you enjoyed your pizza!

text: I'LL NEVER COME BACK! About a year ago, my gf and I thought we would try this place, as we were craving some NY-style pizza ahead of the Cowboys vs Eagles game. I placed an order over the phone and picked it up. Everything was fine at first and I even checked the pizza before leaving. I only live 7 minutes away and did not make any abrupt stops or turns; I drove normal. When I got home and opened the pizza, all the cheese and toppings had slid to one side. I drove back to the store to ask if they'd make me a new pizza. I don't remember the name of the person I spoke to, but he was very rude. Though he agreed to make me a new pizza, he accused me of dropping the pizza, saying it was my own fault the toppings slid to one side. I did not appreciate him saying it was my fault, so I asked for a refund instead, which he rudely denied. I did get a new pizza but I was very disappointed with the customer service. I'm not the type of person that would make somebody else pay for my wrongdoing; his false accusation was a stab at my integrity, which I did not appreciate. For this reason, I will never return to Tony's; instead, I will always choose Paisano's Pizza.

text:
My husband & I are from Fredericksburg. I’ve been wanting to try Ethiopian food for a few weeks now. Came across this gem on goggle. We wanted to check it out based on the reviews.

This place is AMAZING! The food was great! I’m vegan - so lots of options. Which is always nice! Our waitress was so pleasant & knowledgeable. Since it was our first time, she asked about dietary restrictions & guided us on what she recommended.

You really get the cultural feel here which I love. It’s SUPER clean. & Really nice/clean bathrooms! Just love everything about this place! We’ll definitely be back! (:

name: Rayvin gal
text: We went with a group of four. The food was AMAZING. Extremely flavorful, and you certainly do not leave hungry. 1 combination platter is more than enough for 2 people! The service was excellent. Our glasses were never empty, and they were always checking up on us to make sure we were all good! However, not so often that it was annoying or anything of that nature. We ordered 2 combination platters, and they offered to bring it out on one big plate. To that, we said yes please! They have a variety of spicy foods, as well as "spice quenchers", so to speak. Every time someone at our table took a bite, it was accompanied by sounds of delight. The food was ridiculously inexpensive too! We left paying ~$60 in total, before tip, for 4 people. We are certainly coming back again, and cannot wait to try other delicious foods!

text: If you like the big box national chain restaurants you have plenty of options on the outskirts of town. If you want to support downtown, local restaurants your options are more limited. However, limited in number doesn't mean limited in quality. The Green Leaf Grill is reasonably priced and serves good food. On my last visit I had the fish tacos and they were delicious... Highly recommended! Support local merchants.

They even have fried alligator on the menu! I tried it for the first time last week and it was actually really good. This is my go-to spot for date night (live music is always great). Or if i want to order to go, or eat at the bar with a beer! Service and food has always been top notch. Definitely a Waynesboro staple!

This past weekend however while waiting for my wife and I went to sit at the bar we were having a private conversation and I no sooner sat down and the "bartender/manager" decided to inject himself into our conversation in a rather aggressive manner and I, unfortunately, and out of my nature fell for his game and rebutted and he began an argument with me. +I even told him that he injected himself into a private conversation and said we would be happy to leave and take out business elsewhere. He stated he did not need or want my business so we left. I returned to ask the hosted who this man was and if he was the manager he immediately began to verbally attack me in front of other guests reasserting his apparent dominance and assuring me he was the manager and they were no one else above him for me to talk to. We left went to another restaurant and had a wonderful dinner and to say the least were treated with respect.

name: Josiah Rentschler
text:
Edit 5/10/2018, the review I posted before is not visible, it has been reposted below.

I came here with my girlfriend for a birthday getaway. It was later in the evening but still fairly busy.

The staff:
The staff were very polite. We were seated quickly and our waitress took our orders promptly.

The venue:
Fairly nice, live music and decent lighting. The booth we were seated in was falling apart though, very rickety.

The food:
We originally ordered the stuffed chicken breast and the lamb rack with a side of oysters. After several minutes our waitress returned and informed us they were out of lamb. No big deal, I ordered the grilled salmon. Several minutes the waiter returned again "we are out of salmon". At this point it felt like we were trapped in a Weird Al song and all I was going to get was a box of half starved crazed weasels. I ordered the duck instead.

When the food came, we were shocked by the portion sizes, and the stark presentation, and not in a good way. Portions were small, and it looked like they had slapped the chicken and duck on a plate with the sides, while blindfolded. When it came to eating it, it was not much better. The chicken was very dry and the stuffing had very little flavor. The duck was just duck, it was average and nothing spectacular. The oysters were very small, and for the price, very disappointing. The sides (we asked for spinach instead of fries) was over salted and had a very strong seasoning that overwhelmed everything (Old Bay maybe? MSG?). The salads were OK.

Summary:
When we walked in we did not know what to expect. The restaurant has many good reviews, so it had to be decent right? Wrong. The Green Leaf Grill is a sad representation of Cajun food and a disgrace to southern food in general. The mediocre quality of food served here coupled with the exorbitant prices is exceedingly disappointing.

To give you perspective, we stopped at a gas station after leaving and got some cheese and beef jerky (because we were both still hungry), which not only tasted better but was also cheaper and of better quality than Green Leaf.

Take the extra 20 minutes and drive to a restaurant that will serve you a decent meal, and will have the ingredients for what is on the menu.

resp.text: Hi Josiah I’m just checking to see if you could tell me what went wrong at the green leaf grill as you can see from other reviews this is not the typical experience. Thanks Chris

text: This is a really good restaurant. Had their alligator balls as an appetizer and veal breast with mash potatoes and asparagus.   The gravy on the veal ribs was great.  The next night I tried the gumbo and the crawfish etouffee. Big mistake! This chef has no concept of what a gumbo or an etouffee is basically supposed to be. Etouffee means smothered; this was just green peppers, tomatoes, onions and crawfish in a thin watery sauce over rice. The gumbo was the same way. I suggest they remove these items from their menu and stick to cooking what they are good at.

name: Aarti Bansal
text:
It's easy to see why this place gets a 4.5 stars - stupendous service, great drink menu, and wonderful food. Ask researching veggie friendly places to eat in Waynesboro (there aren't really any) and reading all the wonderful reviews, I decided to try out Green Leaf Grill and see for myself.

Thanks to other Yelp reviews, I went with the Coconut Curry with Tofu. OMG - it's delicious! Reminds me of when I went to Singapore and got this amazing Malaysian curry. The curry was  honestly that good at Green Leaf. I know...weird, considering how can an American restaurant  make such good Asian food?! The curry is rich and packed with flavor. It's not greasy. I love the tofu bites, perfectly crispy, I devoured them. The portion size is quite generous, I ate about 1/2 and was stuffed! Very tempted to bring home the leftovers.

My fiancee enjoyed the salmon and enjoyed his meal, it was perfectly cooked.

I'm impressed that Green Leaf carries 4 different flavors of Bold Rock cider. My fiancee got the Bold Rock apple and blood orange cider (which is their newest). I got a glass of Pino Noir. We both enjoyed our drinks and the ciders were only $4 each.

The best part of the meal was Destiny, our server. She was so friendly and served our food with a sweet warm smile. I'm glad that I went with her recommendations (the raspberry vinaigrette goes well with the house salad).

Overall, a great meal that didn't break the bank. Will def be back and want to try out more menu items, although not sure if I can pass up that curry.

text: Health Nut is a great place to get all of your organic ingredients, vitamins, foods, body products and more! They have a great mix of brands and options for everyone! I’d say the only slight downside would be the prices are just a little above other stores but hey it’s worth shopping at. Definitely recommend everyone giving it a try!

text: If its a first time visit, you will be confused at first. Google maps gives the wrong entrance info. Inside the store is very nice. I now know where to get all of my essentials. They have a lot of things to choose from.

name: Matt Postak
text: Great food and of course cider!  Stunning location with several nice paths along their beautiful stream.  If you walk down to the stream there are a few rocks that make great photo-ops.  On the right day sit down and drink your cider with water running over your feet.  Man....do I wish they'd bring their NACHOS back!!!!!

resp.text: Matt, thanks so much for the kind words! Happy to hear you enjoyed your visit, and we have shared your feedback about the nachos with our culinary team. Hope to see you again soon, cheers!

name: Connie Sparks
text:
Always a great time going here. This is truly my happy place.

Although, be warned, things have changed since Covid and you will have to wait at the door for a ticket number for a table. We didnt know that and came in the back way. Which is fine because they have added a ton of picnic tables in their field. Also their food menu has changed. I missed them having the fruit and cheese board but what we did order still was yummy.

The watermelon & blackberry seasonal ciders were super yummy. All in all we had a wonderful time.

name: EM EN
text: Nice place.  They sell a pretty good assortment of beer and seltzer drinks too if cider isn't your thing.  Food wasn't great so eat before you go there are plenty of good places to catch a bite in the area.

name: Colleen Larkins
text: Bold Rock Brewery is set in a beautiful part of the mountains.  You can eat inside or you can have a picnic on their meadow by the river.  During the summer they have movie nights and food trucks.  It's a beautiful place to visit and their cider is amazing.  The only suggestion would be bring your own food, we've ordered food there several times and it's never been all that great.  So pack a picnic get a flight of cider and enjoy the scenery!

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback Colleen! We appreciate the continued support and have shared your feedback about the food with our culinary team. We will work hard to continue to always strive to provide the best food offerings possible and hope you will order food with us sometime soon as we continue to innovate and evolve our menu offerings. Cheers!

name: Eddie Gustin Jr
text: Great place! I've loved Bold Rock Cider for years as its really smooth and tastes good, and now that I've been to the cidery I feel like my experience is complete. They have all the Cider flavors you could want, as well as many flavors that they only offer here! The staff were nice and knowledgeable, and the test drinks I ordered were as good as i knew they would be. They even have a stage in the back for concerts and a river for kids to play in when it gets warmer. All and all this seems like a great place to come and try drinks, but if you are coming to try ciders maybe come when the weather is warmer so you can go swimming afterwards! We decided to stop here with my grandfather during our ski vacation during the school year to get away from the stress of university life and the calming atmosphere of the alcohol and river make for quite a unique trip. I could see this as a great place to bring someone on a date, as it might be fun to sit on one of the rocks near the river and relax for some time. I will sure to return again once the weather warms up enough to go dip my feet in the water!

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful feedback about your visit Eddie! We are thrilled to hear you enjoyed everything and can't wait to have you back again soon. Cheers!

name: Andrew G
text: We found very good attention to COVID protocols, clean and well laid out indoor and outdoor dining. The nachos were superb, the pretzel was disappointing. Their non alcoholic cider was really nice and subtle

resp.text: Andrew, thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback! We are glad to hear you enjoy your visit overall and have shared the feedback about the pretzel with our culinary team. We are always looking for ways to improve the experience for our guests, and appreciate the valuable feedback. Hope we see you again soon! Cheers!

name: Bj M
text: Delicious food. Good prices. BEAUTIFUL SCENERY

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words BJ! Hope you can make it back again soon. Cheers!

name: Ryan Ireland
text: Man oh man, I love this place. The nice part is you could kill off the better part of a day just wondering around the property. There’s a creek not too far out the back door where you can sit down on a rock and enjoy a nice cold glass of cider. The main hall it’s sort of a big beer hall. The food there’s nothing to write home about, but the cider is certainly noteworthy and that is why you were here. In the evening, head down to the barrelhouse. That is where all the really cool, limited run ciders are kept.

resp.text: Ryan, thank you for the kind words! So happy to hear you enjoyed your visit overall, and hope to see you again soon! In regards to the food, we have shared this feedback with our culinary team and will continue to work hard to serve the most fresh and delicious food possible. If you have any additional information about your experience with the food we would love to hear it, feel free to reach out to our GM Alex at aosterhoudt@boldrock.com. Thanks again for the support, cheers!

name: Becky Bergemann
text: I am so in love with Bold Rock! I haven't found a cider made by them that I don't like! We've made several weekend trips from the Hampton Roads area with one of the primary reasons to being to visit Bold Rock. They have a ton of outdoor space, lots of ciders and alternate local beer choices if for some reason you don't want cider. I love going down to the Meadow area and sitting by the river/stream. On this last visit, they had a cider made with Carolina Reaper peppers and my hubby, the spicy pepper guy, loved it. I really enjoyed the winter spice cider they just introduced. We spent time at the Barrel Barn too, because there was a wedding happening at the main building. That also was quite nice, with lots of picnic tables set up outside. On a Friday night they had live music playing which was nice. The only thing I didn't absolutely love was the big soft pretzel we ordered. It was kind of cold and not very good.

resp.text: Becky, thanks for checking us out, we appreciate the kind words and hope to see you again soon. We also would like to thank you for sharing some feedback about the pretzel, we will be sure to discuss with our culinary team and ensure we are doing everything in our power to make sure the pretzels are always served hot and fresh! Cheers!

name: April Ford
text: All-around great experience. We were quickly seated with a beautiful view close to the bar. I was never really a cider fan and had come here with a friend. I fell in love with the IPA that I tried. The surroundings and building, very comfortable setting, very clean and staff was super professional and accommodating. Can't wait to go back

resp.text: April, thank you for the kind words! We are thrilled to hear you enjoyed everything and can't wait to have you back again soon. Thanks again for the support. Cheers!

name: Tracy Schmidt
text: What a fun experience with friends.  Love the openness and the food was fast.  Had to stand in line for a little while.. but  not bad for a weekend.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Tracy, happy to hear you enjoyed your visit! We are deploying some creative ways to help deal with the long lines when we are busy. Hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Gabriel Gorin
text: We love the place! Open space int he back, beautiful scenery, a small creek and good cider!

name: Forrest Lloyd
text: We love coming to bold rock! They have amazing outdoor space, and are very organized and thorough with COVID precautions. Not to mention the amazing cider. Every time we are in the area we have to stop here at least once!

resp.text: Thanks for the awesome feedback Forrest! We appreciate the support and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Ciara Collier
text: Beautiful mountain views, great atmosphere, wonderful cider on tap and to purchase. Great place to unwind, relax and spend time with family & friends.

resp.text: We appreciate the wonderful feedback Ciara! Thanks for stopping in, hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Marshelle Marshall
text: Great cider and atmosphere. The flights are a good value. Get there early because it does fill up fast. The food was just average.

resp.text: Marshelle, thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback from your visit! We are happy to hear you enjoyed the cider and atmosphere and appreciate the kind words! If you have any additional feedback about the food you had we would love to hear it. We are continuously looking for opportunities to improve the experience for our guests and would love to hear more. Feel free to reach out to our GM Alex at aosterhoudt@boldrock.com with any additional information. Thank you again for your support, hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Laura Porter
text: Drinks were great. Best cider hands down! Taking off one star because the table we were assigned to was rather close to the dog waste bin and the smell was awful. The waitstaff let us move though which was nice. Much better experience after moving tables.

resp.text: Laura, thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback from your visit! It's feedback like this that helps us to continue to improve in order to better serve our guests. We believe we know which table you are referring to and would like to assure you we have rearranged our table placement to avoid this from happing again. Again we appreciate you bringing this to our attention, and hope you will come see us again soon. Cheers!

name: Manuel Martinez
text: This is a great cidery and location to explore all that Bold Rock offers. The venue is great, very spacious with expansive outdoor and indoor seating as well as open fields to simply chill. A bit disappointed they did not carry their brand new flavors such as their Hard lemonade and Bolder lemonade during my first visit as that was why I decided to check it out. Nevertheless, the place and drinks are still great and will revisit hopefully when they carry their new selection.

resp.text: Manuel, thank you for stopping by and taking the time to leave us some feedback! We are glad to hear you enjoyed your visit overall and appreciate the feedback in regards to the tea and lemonade. Unfortunately we are not yet able to carry the product due to some ABC restrictions, but we are working hard to get it resolved and hope to have them available real soon! In the meantime don't hesitate to reach out to info@boldrock.com anytime and we will be happy to help navigate you towards a store that carries these products! Thank you again for checking us out, we hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

text: The best place on earth! ❤ Ok well for me it is! It's beautiful, the ciders on drafts are amazing and it's always an amazing time!

resp.text: Thank you for the kind words, we are so happy to hear you enjoyed everything and can't wait to have you back again soon. Cheers!

resp.text: Felicia, so glad to hear you enjoyed your visit :) Thank you for the kind words, hope we see you again soon! Cheers!

name: JB
text: Stocked up for a bachelorette party. Freaking love this stuff!!!

name: Mindy Gholson
text: Yesterday we had made reservations to go to Bold Rock and when we got there, there was NO parking anywhere!!  The line to get in was at least 50 people deep.  They were letting people in that did not have reservations and it was a cluster.  We didn't stay.  Why ask for reservations if you let a thousand people in and there is no where to park or sit??

name: Ashley Emerson
text: Great for a nice outdoor setting! Peaceful!

name: Gordon Shaffer
text: Times are slow w Covid but the hard cider keeps flowing. 50% capacity & social distancing is strictly monitored.  You're assigned a table at the entrance.  There is plenty of seating outdoors.  The food was alright.  My grilled 3 cheese pannani was  tepid and lacked any real taste.  The highlight was the warmed apple turnover w real whip cream.  Definitely try it!

name: Paige Hopkins
text: Experience was great! Especially safety and social distancing. Cider was good, and food was pretty good. Got the chicken Cobb salad, just wish the ranch was thicker (a bit watery). Wings were good and very crispy!

resp.text: Paige, thank you so much for the kind words! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and look forward to having you back again soon! We appreciate the feedback on the ranch as well, we will work with our culinary team to ensure we are doing everything we can to continuously improve the quality of our food. Cheers!

name: Nate
text: This place is great, the ciders on tap are very good and there's lots of indoor and outdoor seating. There's even a small stream you can sit by while you enjoy your ciders. My only complaints are that only one of the outdoor picnic tables had an umbrella and it was very sunny and that the food is OK at best, but it's not a restaurant so I don't really expect it to have great food.

resp.text: N8tedoggYT, thank you for checking us out and taking the time to leave us some feedback! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your visit overall and appreciate the feedback as it helps us to continue to improve our operations. You will be happy to hear we have more umbrellas on the way and should have those out for use very shortly. We will also continue to work with our culinary team to improve our food offerings in any way possible, if you have any specifics about which food items you ordered and how we could improve them we would love to hear from you. Feel free to email our General Manager Alex at aosterhoudt@boldrock.com at any time with any additional feedback. We appreciate your support and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Jeffrey Hatfield
text: Always enjoy this stop, great cider and great views of the mountains.

resp.text: Thanks for making the stop Jeffrey! We appreciate the continued support, cheers!

name: Amber E.
text: Beautiful scenery and atmosphere. Dog friendly!

resp.text: Happy to hear you enjoyed your visit Amber, hope you and your furry friend(s) can make it back again soon. Cheers!

name: Iriana Cruz
text: Loved it! They did not have flights for tasting the beers, only reason is missing 1 star.

resp.text: Iriana, thank you for stopping by and for the feedback! We will hopefully have flight back in a couple weeks! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your visit, and look forward to having you back soon!

name: Kathy Talley
