resp.text: Thank you Kathy! We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visit, and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Andre Ortiz
text: Had a great time in a welcoming place. Great cider that I brag about whenever I'm out of town. Amazing food options too.

resp.text: Thank you, Andre!

name: Trae Payne
text: It's a great place whether it's a friend outing, family thing or a date spot. Good for every occasion place plus bold rock has some of the best hard cider around

resp.text: We appreciate the kind words Trae! Thanks for stopping by, hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Jody Allen
text: We love this place! Has a great view out back, lots of seating! And it's a halfway point that we get to see our college kid more often with less of a drive for all of us!

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words Jody! We're happy we get to be your go to spot for family reunions, hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Mac McManus
text: Fun place even with Covid and Social distancing. Nice view and heated outdoor area.

resp.text: Mac, thanks so much for the wonderful feedback! We're thrilled you enjoyed everything and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: awesome jay like and subscribe
text: Beautiful day! BR very busy!

name: Pete Pete Pete
text:
Fantastic place to take friend, family, a date, etc—even if you don't like cider! They've got great food, other drinks besides cider, a lovely area to walk around, and more.

They do a summer movie fest which I highly recommend going to. They have a band play then it's followed up with a similarly themed movie.

They've got a big fire pit and food trucks come out from time to time for special events.

You can tour the cider house, buy cider directly in bottles and growlers, and even get some cool swag along the way.

resp.text: Thank you, Pete!

name: Trami Pham
text: Great food and cider. You can make a reservation or picnic out on the lawn. Staff are very careful about disinfecting tables.

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful feedback Trami! We are happy to hear you enjoyed everything and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Kim Murray
text: I've only been here twice...once in 2019 and again in 2020 during Covid times. Employees are friendly, love the flights, took a little while to get food but I think kitchen just got an influx of orders.  Outdoor seating options were nice but tables were not placed for social distancing. Other than that no major issues, looking forward to going back

resp.text: Kim, thank you for visiting and for the wonderful feedback! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your visit overall and appreciate you letting us know about the tables. We have a table layout that is designed for optimal social distancing, so some of the table must have gotten shifted around. We will ensure moving forward all tables are kept in their proper location as to ensure the safety and comfortability of all of our guests! Thank you again for taking the time to leave this, it is feedback like this that helps us to learn and improve our operations during these challenging times. Hope to see you again soon! Cheers!

name: dpb
text: Excellent ciders, hamburgers, staff and beautiful grounds.

resp.text: Thank you for the wonderful feedback! Thrilled to hear you enjoyed everything, and hope we get to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: T M
text: Please serve beer at the meadow so we don't have to walk a mile...

resp.text: Hey TM, thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback! We are working on some big plans for down in the meadow and will start drink and food service down there very soon. So sorry we were not able to make it happen on your last visit, but hope you will come back to enjoy our new meadow bar sometime soon. Cheers!

name: Julia Weisberg
text: Not only is Bold Rock one of my favorite drinks but their venue is even better. The food selection is a wide variety and is delicious. Everything is very reasonably priced as well. I have been there three times now and will continue to go back.

name: Wendy Higgins
text: Great food for cider pairing! Try an apple grilled cheese!

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Wendy, so happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and look forward to having you back again soon. Cheers!

name: Chris Darko
text: Great place to visit,  but all the cider drinks taste the same

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback Chris, we appreciate the support! If you have any additional feedback from your visit we would love to hear it. Anything we could have done to make your experience more enjoyable, we are open ears! Feel free to reach out to our General Manager Alex at aosterhoudt@boldrock.com with any additional feedback. Cheers!

name: Joseph Cassidy
text: It was awesome and super kid friendly.  We brought our 2 and 4 y/o and sat outside in the sun while we tried both flights.  Lots of room for the kiddos to run around and very friendly staff.  Also dog friendly on and off leash.  Will definitely go back.

name: william helser
text: First time there and will definitely go back. Loved the atmosphere and the cider!

resp.text: Awesome feedback, thanks for checking us out William! We're happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Meredith Clark
text: Great set up to keep everyone healthy and safe! Enjoyed the code and the view!

resp.text: Meredith, thank you for the wonderful feedback! We are exCIDERed to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Josh Rees
text: No other cider compares to Bold Rock. Nestled in the middle of the blue ridge mountains, this brewery is breathtaking. The food is amazing and the staff is very helpful. Also, the service is pretty quick. It’s a great place to bring friends and family!

name: Melanie Howard
text: Reservation was good. Had a great time with friends!

resp.text: Thanks for the wonderful feedback Melanie! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our reservation system and hope we can have you back again soon. Cheers!

name: Mike Abbruscato
text: My favorite cidery in the country! This place has the best cider, only slightly sweet with plenty of flavor options. But the cidery itself with worth the trip! Beautifully located in the blue ridge mountains, you will thoroughly enjoy every minute of your cider sipping!

resp.text: Mike, we really appreciate the kind words! Happy to hear you had a relaxing visit and hope you can make a return trip sometime soon. Cheers!

name: Michael Raynes
text: Fresh draft cider from local apples, good appetizers, friendly staff in a beautiful atmosphere.

resp.text: Michael, you hit it all! Thank you so much for the support and the kind words, hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Haseeb Mohammed
text: Great food and bear. Lots of hand sanitizer everywhere. Service was excellent. Bathrooms were really clean. Overall outstanding experience

resp.text: Haseeb, thank you for the kind words! We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us some feedback, and we're happy to hear you enjoyed your visit. Hope to see you again soon, cheers!

name: Melissa Kehl
text: I love their cider and it was a pretty place to visit. The cheese that came with the pretzel we had was less than stellar, but still was a great experience.

resp.text: Melissa, thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your visit overall. We will be sure to share your feedback on the cheese sauce with our culinary team, and see what we can do to ensure we are serving the best quality food possible. Thanks for stopping by, hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: G E
text: Awesome property with great views.  I am not even a cider drinker (too sweet) but it is worth stopping here along the 151 trail to check out the place and spend some time with friends.

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words GE! Appreciate you checking us out and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Bernie Klein
text: The best place to get a pint of cider!

resp.text: Bernie, thanks so much for the kind words! We appreciate you checking us out and look forward to seeing you again soon. Cheers!

name: Michael Ayers
text: One of my favorite places in Virginia. Cider is delicious, the grounds are beautiful and spacious and the views are amazing!!!

resp.text: Awesome feedback, thanks so much Michael! We appreciate you checking us out and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Megan Chapman
text: Second time visiting and I will continue to return! The ciders are amazing, even their seasonal selections are always on point. Their food is great and the service lacks nothing! One of my favorite return visits!

resp.text: Thank you, Megan!

name: Jenna Fitz
text: Had an amazing time visiting! Love their cider! Had the new rose was amazing! The food was good too! We went when they had a live band. Tons of places to sit and enjoy the atmosphere. Enjoyed sitting outside near the fire pit. It’s located at such a beautiful spot.

name: JOHN BRANSFORD
text: We went to Carters Mountain then we went to Bold Rock . Good Food and Drink and Awesome  Views . Will Go Back .

resp.text: Awesome to hear it, thanks for the kind words John! Hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Debbie Key
text: Beautiful setting, an array of cider flavors and foods to go with them.

resp.text: Thrilled to hear you enjoyed everything Debbie! Thank you for stopping by, hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: christine byrne
text: A must on your 151 trail or wintergreen trip. Lovely property with a creek down the hill for rock stacking, delicious ciders, live music, fantastic wings!!

resp.text: We were wondering who stacked all those rocks by the river, thanks for creating some artwork for us! We appreciate the kind words, and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Paul Davies
text: This place is great, lovely views, a nice patio and walks down to the river with seating. This is one of the better places to come while on 151.

resp.text: Paul, thanks so much for the kind words! We appreciate you checking us out, and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Julia Stewart
text: How amazing! We discovered this place on the way back from a hike and I'm so glad we did! I had the traditional green apple cider, which was delicious as always, but everything else about Bold Rock was incredible too. The staff were so welcoming, there is a viewing hall of the bottling process and a tiny museum of how cider is made, and they apparently offer tours every hour as well. The building has a rustic log cabin feel and they also have a gorgeous deck overlooking the mountains. I didn't try to food but it looked very good.  I'm usually more of a winery person, but Bold Rock is really an impressive place, I highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you, Julia!

name: Christie Ray Harrison
text: Perfect spot to get a cider and burger and sit outside in the summer! Bring a group and sit on the porch at sunset with mountain views, or come for one of their special events like movie screenings on the back lawn, food trucks, etc. recommend checking their calendar for special events. The cider is some of the best I’ve tasted, with such great variety of options and seasonal brews.

resp.text: Thank you, Christie!

name: Berend van Roijen
text: A go to favorite. I've introduced friends and out of towners and everyone enjoys a visit to Bold Rock. Great drinks, scenic views, good food, and a laid back vibe makes this an easy place to spend an hour or an afternoon.

resp.text: Awesome feedback, thanks Berend! Thank you for stopping by and bringing friends, hope we see you again soon!

name: Kari Ann Ramsey
text: seasonal peach cider on tap was delicious!

name: kenneth seal
text: Attentive staff,  great cider, amazing facility, good food. Looking forward to next time!

resp.text: We're looking forward to having you back Kenneth! Thanks for checking us out, we appreciate the kind words. Cheers!

name: Rick Goodman
text: Excellent spot to bring friends and hang out. Great seasonal ciders right now. Love the IPA and pineapple.

name: Elizabeth B.
text: Went for Mother's day brunch.  Mimosa was good, pancakes were delicious!  Forgot to get a picture of the pancakes before we devoured them...

resp.text: Thank you, Elizabeth!

name: Curtis Diesselhorst
text: Always great. View is spectacular, ciders are amazing, and food is good too.

resp.text: Thank you for leaving us some feedback, hope you can visit again soon!

name: Meg Turley
text: One of my favorite places when visiting Charlottesville! Their IPA cider is amazing! The atmosphere is relaxing and the views are gorgeous! Highly recommend if you are in the Charlottesville area.

name: Leslie Powers
text: Loved everything!  The ciders and the scenery!  A must trip!

resp.text: Leslie, thanks so much for the wonderful feedback! Thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visit, and look forward to having you back for another trip. Cheers!

name: Morgan Daly
text: I love Bold Rock. Not even the biggest Cider fan but I come just for the views

resp.text: Thanks for the support Morgan, we do have some of the best views around! Hope we see you again soon, cheers!

name: David Andra
text: The Bold Rock tap room provides excellent scenery to enjoy the delicious ciders they offer.

name: Steven Dillon
text: Awesome! Can't get any better. Can't wait to go back.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the kind words Steven! Were happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and can't wait for you to come back either!

name: Gary Henderson
text: Great friends,  great fall day and a cold bold rock, life is complete!

resp.text: Gary, couldn't ask for more! Glad to hear you enjoyed your visit, hope we see you again soon!

name: edwin hosier
text: Nice place.  Food was good but not much of a menu.  I'll eat there again.

name: Clinton Lewis
text: This is a large facility that offeres room to hang out unside and out. Lots to offer, they have the seasonal ciders and their flagships. Also offere them in bottles for off site consumption. Lots of merch too. Decent food to with specials. I got the cheese plat and it was nice. Will stop by again if in the area.

name: Michelle Metzger
text: Love the view in the back!

resp.text: Michelle, happy to hear you got to enjoy the wonderful views! Hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Christopher Pine
text: Nice large place. Open with lots of seating, stages and outside areas.  Good food and good drinks.

name: Tina Johnston
text: Love their pineapple cider, their summer flavor.  The creek felt good after being in the sun.

name: arlie via
text: Great place great beer great people

resp.text: Thank you for the awesome feedback Arlie Via! We are thrilled to hear you enjoyed everything and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Greg Travassos
text: This is a cool place.  Depending on when you go, you can stop in and see their factory where you can observe the machines filling bottles and the workers packing them up.  They have well priced ciders and are all gluten-free.  Sit out back and enjoy the view of the mountains.  Definitely recommend checking this place out

name: Tyler McCullough
text: Beautiful views and a great setting even if you aren't a fan of cider.

name: Ileana Gonzalez
text: Grilled cheese sandwich is good.  Flights are generous compared to another cidery I visited.

name: Dustin Jacobs
text: Love going to this chill place. Wish they had their full menu the last time but covid is getting to all businesses

resp.text: Dustin, thank you for the kind words! We are working on some kitchen updates, and will hopefully be able to roll out our full menu sometime soon. Stay tuned, cheers!

name: Connie Eddins
text: Food used to be better but I can understand the issues due to Covid19 have probably caused this issue

name: Diana Cantillo
text: Great service and location

name: Hector Vazquez
text: Great place! Awesome views!

name: Mary Micucci
text: Great first visit after self isolation. They are well prepared for social distancing. The food and drinks are always the best!

name: Amisha Prabhakar
text: One of my favorite  Place to hangout, Beautiful  View, Great cider....Always wins heart 😍🥰

name: Sarah Mariano
text: Sat in the meadow drinking hard cider ! It was so relaxing  !

resp.text: Sounds relaxing! Thanks for sharing Sarah! Happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Ryan
text: The best view, food, and of course ciders

resp.text: Ryan, appreciate the kind words and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Conner Grant
text: The location is awesome, I could spend quite a bit of time here just enjoying the sights and the cider. The cider is delicious and they have a lot of choices. I've been here a couple times and have never been disappointed. If you aren't sure what you like go with one of the flights they offer and then go from there. Definitely will be returning!

name: fred Strick
text: Always great, best cider 👍

resp.text: Thanks for checking us out! Happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Missouri Vaughan
text: Great escape with lovely views and delicious cider!

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by Missouri! We're thrilled you enjoyed your visit and hope you can make it back again soon. Cheers!

name: Adena Dannouf
text:
Beautiful land and building, comfortable and informative. A good way to spend a couple of hours your first time in. A good place to hang out and relax any other time.

Limited food choices, but understandable as food isn't the focus. Have a vegetarian burger option... (but they were out when we came 🙁)

name: Sarah Ouellette
text: Love this cidery. Vintage is the champagne of ciders!

resp.text: Sarah, thank you for the kind words! We are happy to hear you enjoyed your visit and specifically the Vintage Dry. Thank you for your continued support, cheers!

name: Jeff DeSchon
text: Great selection. Just need more servers.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by Jeff, were happy to hear you enjoyed our selection! We have definitely struggled with staffing during these challenging times, but we are getting there and have recently added some additional servers to our team! Hope you will swing back through sometime soon so we can provide you with an exceptional experience. Cheers!

name: Chris Patton
text: Bold rock is ok to begin with and what's available at the brewery isn't anything unique. We waited over an hour and half for food which came out cold and soggy. We were issued a refund.

resp.text: Chris, thank you so much for taking the time to leave us this feedback! It is feedback like this that helps us improve our operations and better serve our guests. We would like to apologize for the issues with the food and assure you this was an anomaly. We had some unforeseen challenges in our kitchen that day that led to longer than usual wait times. We would like to assure you that we have worked the issue out, and we will continue to work hard to ensure we can serve our delicious food fast, hot, and fresh to all guests visiting our facility. Thank you again for reaching out, we hope you will give us another opportunity to provide you with an exceptional experience! If you have any additional feedback we would love to hear it, feel free to reach out to aosterhoudt@boldrock.com with any feedback or if you plan on making a return. Cheers!

name: Cindy Mitchell
text: Would have been nice to have the tents set up BEFORE it rained. LOL Always one of our favs on 151

resp.text: Cindy, thank you for visiting and for sharing this feedback! We will definitely be sure to have those tents set up early next time to ensure we can keep everyone dry. Hope to see you again soon, cheers!

name: Kevin Gridley
text: I'm not big on ciders, but I found a couple that I really enjoyed. Their outdoor area is as amazing as the view. You can do a tour or you can just walk around and watch them bottle. Very relaxing place, in a beautiful location.

name: Sam Buck
text: We loved Bold Rock Cidery! I had a flight with the VA Apple, VA Draft, Pear, and the seasonal cider, Pineapple, and my wife got the Blackberry cider. All of the drinks were incredible. The VA Draft and Pear were probably my favorites, and they weren't too sweet and were just the right flavor. As for our food, we got the Turkey Club, Pretzel Shareable, Queso/Chips Shareable, and the Wings/Fries. All of them were fantastic, but the Turkey Club sandwich, cheese for both shareables, and the Apple BBQ wing sauce were particularly flavorful, fresh, and tasty. And it was all for $43. Overall, we've been sold, and we can't wait to go back soon!

name: Melanie Hollen
text: A must stop on a 151 tour.

resp.text: Thanks for making the stop Melanie! Thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Matthew Petersen
text: Great place to sit back and relax.  Large outdoor area.

name: Don Young
text: Great food. Great cider. Always

name: jay craig
text: Another great stop. New pineapple seasonal was excellent.

resp.text: Jay, thank you for the kind words! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed the Pineapple, hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Ellen Ledwaba
text: They offer free beer tasting and sell a variety of beer selections. They also have a museum showing how it all started. A good place to go and just relax while enjoying a sip of fresh beer. The staff is also good and service is good. They also have outdoor seating to relax and enjoy

name: jay26tm
text: Only okay for me - I'm not a fan of ciders, and unfortunately, that is the only adult beverage offered there. Great venue, though, with awesome outdoor seating.

resp.text: Jay, thank you for taking the time to leave us some feedback on your visit! We wanted to let you know that we have 10 different craft beers available in cans, as well as 3 canned cocktails, and 4 different hard seltzers. We would like to apologize if these options were not pointed out during your visit, and will work with our staff to ensure this is happening. We would also like to assure you that we will continue to serve beer as well so we encourage you to stop on by again to enjoy our outdoor seating and beautiful views. Cheers!

name: Michelle Ryman
text: I LOVE their cider, all of them, and I enjoy sitting on their large back deck looking down at the field and little stream area. It's one of my favorite stops when we visit the Nelson 151 area! It's a beautiful place... With yummy cider (not too sweet), good food and friendly service! Everyone is so kind and helpful. We'll be back for sure!

resp.text: Thanks, Michelle!

name: Carrie Ross
text: We were really excited to stop in here and sort of disappointed to find out that the free tasting was just a single sample of their seasonal cider (which was good but I would have enjoyed a better tasting experience). The place was packed and it was hard to maneuver without feeling like you were in someone’s way. I’m glad we stopped in but I won’t be back.

name: Misty Hall
text: Great service!

name: David Callahan
text: Great venue, wonderful senic views

resp.text: Thanks for checking us out David! We're thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Kris Denson
text: BOMB. Neat place, good bar food, yummy fresh Cider.

name: Devin M
text:
How could you not love this place? Their so warm and welcoming.

I enjoy the little background they give you when you walk into the tasting room. Their ciders are delicious. They even have a cider brewed with hops. Out of this world!

Come here and relax. I know we did

name: James Stark
text: Cute!  Ok food great ambience. Made the mistake of not trying their home brew cider.

name: Kevin Divins
text: Great experience! Good food and beer! The scenery is great too!

name: Jason Cooper
text: Always great. And epic views. Ciders are excellent as always.

name: Jeannie Boatwright
text: Fun.... and beautiful place to go with great food.  Christy the hostess was Awesome!

resp.text: Thank you, Jeannie!

name: Kyle
text: Amazing cider, great memorabilia. Just stay away from the queso, it's a bit eh!

name: Kerry Miller
text: Beautiful location! Well run during covid plently of space to spread out, and if course top notch cider!

resp.text: Kerry - Many thanks for the vote of confidence, we appreciate you and hope to see you again soon!

name: Bradley Hallier
text: Great experience. You can look into their bottling room and learn about the process on the second floor. Tons of cider flavors, and they recently came out with a coffee flavor.

name: Susan Smith
text: Great cider, friendly staff, awesome gluten free bun on my sandwich, and a view of the Blue Ridge Mountains. Loved it!

name: Steve Hughes
text: Nice relaxed atmosphere, good cider, perfect wayside stop

resp.text: Steve, thanks so much for checking us us, were happy to here you enjoyed your visit and look forward to having you back out to the cidery sometime soon! Cheers!

name: davidutubed
text: Food cider and atmosphere are all great!

resp.text: Thanks David! Happy to hear you enjoyed your visit, hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: John C. Lewis
text: The virginia cider is best .

resp.text: Couldn't agree more John! Happy to hear you enjoyed everything and hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Chip Grimes
text: Now they have sandwiches in addition to the appetizers, our family loves coming here

name: Christina Veland
text: I’ve been to so many breweries so believe me when I say this was the best experience I’ve  had yet. The staff was kind and helpful, and the scenery alone was amazing. There’s a little creek behind the brewery that we explored. We had an awesome time and will make it a point to come here when we travel this way again. 🍻

resp.text: Thanks, Tina!

name: Mark Behnke
text: Always good cider, but they shut down their restaurant even for curbside at 230pm

resp.text: Mark, thank you for checking us out and taking the time to leave us some feedback! You will be happy to hear we have decided to stop booking our main taproom for private events and with the exception of a couple weddings that were already booked, will not be closing our taproom down early moving forward. We appreciate your patience as we work towards solutions to continue to provide our guests with the best experience possible. Cheers!

name: Nip Melton
text: Great venue.   Varied selection of ciders

name: Ben Cokus
text: Great cidery with good tasting selection

resp.text: Happy to hear you enjoyed our delicious cider and selection! Thanks for stopping by, hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: xDCMTx
text: Incredible location. Breathtaking views. Amazing ciders. Cute apple stands. Educational stations for the kids. 6 out of 5 stars

name: Carolyn S
text: Love the cider and the scenery

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words and support Carolyn! Hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Wayne Shumaker
text: Love this place

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words Wayne! Happy to hear you enjoyed your visit. Cheers!

name: Rosemary Seltzer
text: Beautiful place. Great outing!

name: yeldarb 92
text: Crowded, cider is okay, cool atmosphere.

resp.text: Yeldarb 92, thank you for visiting and taking the time to leave us some feedback. As we grow and gain in popularity we are continuously looking for new and innovative ways to offer more space for our guests to hang out. We recommend checking out our meadow area where there is plenty of space to relax and spread out. Thank you for stopping by and hope you will stop on by for another visit sometime! Cheers!

name: CJ Rhodes
text: Great food amazing cider drinks!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the kind words CJ! Glad to hear you enjoyed your visit and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Melissa Riggleman
text: It's my favorite place!

resp.text: So happy to hear that Melissa! We're here anytime you need us ;) Cheers!

name: Jeri Pugh
text: Best cider in VA. Gorgeous views of the mountains from here

name: Richard Lilgeberg
text: Great outdoor seating with a beautiful view and amazing ciders. I debated taking off a star since the food selection is very limited but what they do have is good. We were going to have lunch here but we decided to get a snack instead. Really good soft pretzels. You can get a really good view of the production floor.

name: John Hutchinson
text: Good cider and we were able to taste some unique flavors. We did have to wait several minutes to find a table and it would be nice if there were more seating options.

name: Rachel Swain
text: Loved the pineapple cider slushies and view

resp.text: Rachel, thank you for checking us out and appreciate the feedback on the slushees! Happy to hear you enjoyed your experience and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Tracey Kite
text: Hosted a group outing for 60 at Bold Rock in Nellysford, VA. The event manager (Alex) and his team were extremely organized from initial contact through execution; therefore, creating an outstanding stress-free event for all. They went above and beyond to ensure all attendees felt welcomed and enjoyed their experience. The ciders and food were delicious! Definitely will host events here in the future. Highly recommend! Thank you Bold Rock!

resp.text: Thank you, Tracey!

name: Robert Elliott
text: This is my favorite cidery, their combination is unmatched by most. Had an excellent time getting there early when they opened on my birthday!

name: Sarah Ellis
text: Big operation on beautiful piece of property.  Very neat to see the bottling operation and the large variety of ciders.  I have always enjoyed their ciders and now enjoying their seltzers.  If in the area, worth a stop.

resp.text: Thank you, Sarah!

name: David Cardwell
text: Great place to sit and enjoy the fall colors!!!!

resp.text: We're glad you got to see them this year David! They are stunning indeed, cheers!

name: Kristen Teubert
text: Great views

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by Kristen! We appreciate the support, cheers!

name: Issac Spencer
text: The best love the place

resp.text: You're the best Issac, thanks for the kind words! Cheers!

name: James Whiteside
text: Lovely location with a great deck to enjoy the view. The walk up to the main building is a little long, but very well made and maintained. Ample parking with a lovely facility. I am not a drinker, but I truly enjoyed visiting Bold Rock.

resp.text: Thank you, James!

name: Toni Starling
text: Gorgeous location and the food was great

resp.text: Tori, thanks for the kind words! Were happy to hear you enjoyed everything and hope we see you again soon!

name: Joe Crawford
text: The walk is worth it in end... its actually a bit of a hike uo to the front door

name: Roy Mathew
text: Great place to relax and sample some hard cider. They have various varieties and you can sample them before you buy. They have food also - we tried the loaded tater tots which come bacon and sour cream and was awesome. The location in Afton valley is great - especially to sit outside and enjoy nature

resp.text: Thank you, Roy!

name: Caleb Helmuth
text: Great pork sandwich and environment

resp.text: Caleb, happy to hear you enjoyed the food and environment! Thanks for stopping in and hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Lee Anna Farrall
text: Always enjoy good food, beverages and the atmosphere at Bold Rock Nellysford

name: Amanda Farmer
text: My favorite place on earth ♡

name: Michael Loblanco
text: Very friendly staff, environment very comfortable! Just a cool place to visit

name: Ricardo Rivera
text: Whoever came up with the idea for this place, you deserve all the millions of dollars you are undoubtedly earning now. Forget for a second the quality of the cider, which is very good, and focus just on the grounds themselves. It is a great place to visit with family and friends, the Virginia mountains kneeling before you in all their majesty.

resp.text: Thank you, Ricardo!

name: Wallace Twigg
text: Love the hard cider. It's a haul going up the ramp but worth it.

name: Amber Senters
text: First time here and I throughly enjoyed it. Look forward to going back when its warmer.

name: Robert Carpenter
text: Great place. Terrific environment and a good product.

name: David Abraham
text: I'm not a cider person but this is good stuff!
Good, not a huge fan of cider but as it goes, Bold Rock is the household name for a reason. The patio outside has a great view of the blueridge

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Jerry Germond
text: nice place.....great cider

name: Lee Sage
text: Great selection of ciders!

resp.text: Thanks for visiting Lee, happy to hear you enjoyed the selection! Cheers!

name: MrJaglawman
text: Great service. close to home,  good price,  good food,  and  drinks.

name: Demetrius
text: A nice selection of ciders with an unbeatable atmosphere. Wether you are coming for lunch or just stopping by for a drink. You’re sure to have a good visit at Bold Rock.

resp.text: Thank you, Alex!

name: Jim Stallings
text: Great staff

resp.text: So glad to hear you enjoyed your visit Jim! Thanks for stopping by, hope we see you again soon!

name: Joshua Ross
text: Been wanting to go here FOREVER! Huge Cider fan, drove an hour so from Richmond to check this place out. Super impressed, staff was great, ciders were on point! Even had these "drier" than normal versions that I've never seen before. They were amazing! My favorite was the IPA Cider, knocked my socks off. Being right at the base of Blue Ridge Mountains, on a GORGEOUS October fall day, with some amazing cider and atmosphere, it was a fantastic experience!

name: Emily Elizabeth
text: Great place - I have always loved their cider and the atmosphere of this place only adds to it! Great prices on cases of cider - came home with a few. There is nothing better than cider on draft though and their food was delicious as well. Go for the s'mores panini and prepare to have your mind blown. This will always be a stop if we are in the area!

resp.text: Thank you, Emily!

name: Shane Harlacher
text: Wonderful views.  Great cider. Fantastic staff.  Stop here.  You will love it!

resp.text: Thank you for the kind words Shane! Thrilled to hear you enjoyed your visit and look forward to seeing you again soon. Cheers!

name: Elizabeth Kennedy
text: I am all about Bold Rock. Their presentation is unmatched and their venue is fantastic. The only thing I don’t like is how crowded this venue becomes, especially with children. On peak days it can be hard to find a quiet spot to enjoy the views and listen to the creek flow without the sound of screaming kids. I do find their prices reasonable, especially by the growler. My favorite is their Blood Orange cider. I haven’t tasted a cider that wasn’t delicious from Bold Rock though and I enjoy the ski-lodge feel that the venue has. Always very clean, too.

name: Josh Rowland
text: Sample rack , each was delicious , views are beautiful and food was tasty. Will be coming back

name: Bruce Lowe
text: We visited this place in August to finally check it out. The atmosphere is great, the food looked delicious and plenty to share with friends. I highly recommend stopping here on your travels by the blue ridge parkway, or in general. Great place; I'm definitely going back.

name: Thomas L. Durbin
text: Very best and well kept

name: Rob B.
text: This place is cool.  Nice tasting room, outdoor seating area and a wide open field that leads down to a creek.  We brought our dog, drank a few ciders and played cards on one of the picnic tables.  Good food too!  I would definitely recommend, even if cider isn't your drink of choice.  Go, bring the kids & dogs, and enjoy!

name: Bianca Loredo
text: Great food and cider

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words Bianca, hope to see you again soon! Cheers!

name: Dona Smallwood-Carneal
text: Always so tasteful!

name: Demian Perry
text: The cider selection is fantastic and lighter on the alcohol than the local beers, so you can drink here all day.  They also have a non-alcoholic cider that is perfect for anyone (not just kids), but it's a nice touch that makes this place more family friendly than most breweries.  I was also impressed with their food service system, which is speedy and efficient.  Only complaint is that the IPA is a failed taste experiment.  But every other cider and perry I tried was magnificent!

name: suzy kid
text: Love this place

resp.text: Thanks for the kind words Suzy! Hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Caleb Allen
text: We went to the lower of the two buildings on Bold Rock's property. Our bartender Cory was a very fun, entertaining guy and he seemed to really enjoy talking with us. My wife and I sampled all of the cider available on tap free of charge (Please tip well if you do this). The atmosphere was chill, it wasn't too busy on the Friday evening we visited, and we had a good time.

name: David Wyatt
text: Okay place.

resp.text: Hey David, thank you for taking the time to leave us a review! We are always looking for opportunities to improve upon the experience for our guests and would love any additional details you may be able to provide about your visit! We will continue to work hard to improve and better serve our guests. Please feel free to email our GM Alex at aosterhoudt@boldrock.com with any additional information. Hope we can get you back out for another visit sometime soon. Cheers!

name: Christina Appleby
text: The cider is good, and the indoor and outdoor seating is fantastic with great views. My only complaint is you can't pick your flights, and the bartender didn't mention what additional ciders/beers were on tap when we walked up.

resp.text: Thank you, Christina!

name: Greg Mestre
text: Bold rock is great.

resp.text: Greg, you're great! Thanks for stopping by, hope to see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Crystal Cornett
text: Extremely delicious food and cider. Very friendly employees. Gorgeous views and cozy atmosphere. Highly recommend.

resp.text: Thank you, Crystal!

name: Steve Lackey
text: Great atmosphere, but super crowded on release party days. Standing room only, and when cold and rainy out a good portion of seating is unavailable. We will always go back though - super friendly staff and a good time!

resp.text: Thank you for the feedback, Steve!

name: Amber Stocker
text:
My girlfriends and I went on a Friday night around 6-8pm. We had a great time! I love Bold Rock ciders and was excited to finally go to the cidery! I was not disappointed. Employees were extremely friendly and helpful.
We did a tasting which included 2 free samples, but with 4 of us sharing that meant we could try them all.  The winter seasonal cider was delicious as well as the others. We got to sit by one of the two fireplaces while talking and drinking our ciders.
We enjoyed going upstairs to watch the bottling process from above and learning the history from the displays on the walls. Overall we had a wonderful experience and will definitely go back!

name: John Owens
text: First time visit and was blown away! Will definitely be making a return trip. Clean, friendly and the staff actually looked you in the eyes when you talked to them.....

resp.text: Thank you, John!

name: Andrew Hicks
text: Good drinks, good food, good times!

name: Ashley Ruffead
text: My favorite cider on Nelson 151. Crisp and  clean ciders, great atmosphere to just hang out and they have some good snacks to munch on while you're enjoying the drinks. In my opinion about half of the ciders are on the sweet side, but I like that; my boyfriend found several ciders he is quite fond of and he tends to like dry ciders.

name: Mattie Dougherty
text: Beautiful location. Perfect cider.

name: Alex Weller
text: The brand new taproom is beautiful and is only superseded by the gorgeous property. Free tastings and a bar where you can buy pints of all of their ciders. The cider is fresh and delicious and they do not back-sweeten so their cider is refreshing and balance. They are doing creative things such as a dry-hopped cider called India Pale Apple as well as pear and honeydew cider.

name: Heather Sellers
text: Hey BR owners-We are fans of your cidery and today experienced a not-so- pleasant  side of your business.We were visiting Blue Toad in Waynesboro, and  a group of your 'managers' were there for a tasting.They announced themselves as 'managers' of Bold Rock and part of'the Industry'.They proceeded to tear apart the ciders at Blue Toad in front of others there, calling it hair dye and vinegar.They were unprofessional and non-discreet to the lone worker there.She, by the way , was wonderful.She listened patiently and offered substitutes, comps. To all the 'non industry' patrons present, it made Bold Rock appear elitist and of poor awareness of customer impact.We thought you may want to know how some of your team is repping your business.Thank you.

resp.text: We are sorry to hear about this experience, Heather. We are addressing the concern.

name: David Keeler
text: This is the place to go for cider.  It may be a bit of a walk up a steep ramp to get into the Cidery but it is worth the walk!!  Inside you will find friendly staff and plenty of chances to taste and sample some great cider.  Make sure to take some time out to get a pint and sit on the back deck and enjoy the Rockfish Vally views!

name: Christina
text: Great Place We Love the Ciders and have made some great friends {family} with the staff especially at Carter's Mountain. Keep Up The Great Work and Keep Hiring Great People My Husband Loves The Apple and Me I Love the DRAFT

resp.text: Thank you, Christina!

name: Katelynn Graham
text: Went for the mothers day steal the pint, it was very fun. Food was average, and expensive. Definitely eat before I go next time.

resp.text: Thank you for the feedback, Katelynn!

name: Tom Ratcliff
text: The dry cider is my new favorite. Cool, laid back place with great options for cider and hanging out. Big TVs to watch the game, ping pong table to beat your kids, sweet outdoor patio with awesome views and fields for kids to run around

name: Matthew Matyjek
text: For us, Bold Rock is worth the 3 hour trip from DC and then some. A truly amazing place, with amazing cider.

resp.text: Thank you, Matthew!

name: David McKenzie
text: It is all about Cider.  Limited, but tasty lunch menu. Lots of different ciders to taste and buy.  Great Vistas of the valley and close in Mountains, eat outside or inside. Kids will love the bottling operation.

name: Melinda Holmes
text: My husband and I loved visiting, we cant wait to come back

resp.text: Thank you, Melinda!

name: Scott Fowler
text: It was great

resp.text: Scott, happy to hear you enjoyed everything! Hope we see you again soon. Cheers!

name: Len Poulin
text: Great atmosphere,  excellent cider and tasty food. Loved the trio playing Christmas music.

name: Ross Agee
text: I credit Bold Rock for making me a fan of hard cider. My fiancé and I stopped in on the recommendation of a friend years ago when this establishment was first in operation. This was before the main production building was built. We absolutely loved the scenery and were impressed that all of the cider was made from apples grown nearby. The vintage ciders exceeded my expectations. Brian Shanks is definitely a master of his craft. I have since bought six pack after six pack of their ciders on my grocery store visits. I can't wait to return to see what has changed over the years!

name: Justin Hormel
text:
Ample parking, even on a beautiful spring Saturday afternoon. Enter the cidery barn,  and a store and bar for free tastings greet you. Around the corner is the bar where one can order food and drink from 4 stations. Take your drinks with you, and the staff will deliver your food to your table when ready. The menu is somewhat limited, but the should be something for everyone, at least adults: sandwiches, salads, appetizers including cheese and charcuterie plates.
Ample tables were available inside. Tables on the patio are harder to come by outside on a beautiful day, but you can always carry ending down to the lower picnic tables by the river. The view outside is gorgeous. Walk down to the water afterward and skip stones before heading out.

name: Austin Graff
text:
Warning: A tour here will make you a brand loyalist to Bold Rock. I promise you that!

Three friends and I went on a weekend camping trip and decided to go to two distilleries, a winery, and Bold Rock. Even though I'm the only cider fan out of my friends, we all agreed the Bold Rock experience was the best one.

First of all, the location of Bold Rock is beautiful (with Black Rock just behind the cidery). The tour and tastings are FREE and the people who work there obviously love their jobs and are people you'd want to be friends with. They have tables to sit at and even have a bean bag game for people to enjoy. They are building a new facilities to open in August 2014 and it is gorgeous (I will be coming back in August!).

The cider is the best I've had. If you are not a cider fan and love beer instead, start with the Virginia Apple draft (It's not sweet). I love sweeter drinks and love the Virginia Draft.

Honestly, everyone needs to make a trip to Nellysford for Bold Rock. They will easily make you a cider advocate.

text: Small, and they have gas. Typical small town gas station and grocery with limited items and overpriced items for convenience. Good when you need one item, and don't want to drive to town.

name: Matt L
text: Recently had two different reservations a week apart be cancelled by Enterprise the day OF the reservation. One of which was made 5 days in advance. Both were the result of not having any vehicles available, even though their website allowed the reservations to be made and I recieved confirmation for both reservations. No accommodations were made, no attempts to find a vehicle for me at another location were made, no attempts to reschedule my reservation were made. 1 out of 5 stars because you can't rate lower.

name: Richard Arehart
text: Very happy with Enterprise. They picked me up in 5 minutes and the sign in process was painless. Had me in a very nice vehicle and on my way in about 10 minutes . The staff was super friendly. I'll definitely use them again when I need a rental vehicle. AAA+++

resp.text: Hi Richard Arehart, we are very happy to have provided you with such a positive experience! Thanks again for taking the time to leave us this information about your recent visit. Take care!  Chris M

name: David Wright
text: Used this service several times and have never had any issues with the people or vehicles I have rented. Will use again when I need a rent-a-car. Rates are in line with area markets.  People are very helpful on getting you the right vehicle for your needs.

resp.text: Hi David, we are very happy to have provided you with such a positive experience! We look forward to your next visit! Take care! - HH

name: Ricardo Rivera
text: The guy who serviced me on the day I visited was quite polite and friendly. He even handed me his business card. You'll recognize him right away if you ever visit here, his name was Colin.

name: Ineke Paschal
text: The staff (Miss Ford and Mr Blue Eyes) here are Awesome Sauce! And made it hassle free. We rented a 15 passenger van to drive to Florida, it was clean, handled every well and was great on gas. The rate of the rental was very reasonable for the amount of days we had it for. I will continue to rent from this location.

name: Stacey Hatter
text: The staff here are wonderful. I rented a vehicle and had to extend for over a week. They made it painless and that was exactly what I needed. Very happy with the service from Taylor, Ben and oh I'm so sorry.... There was another gentleman that helped me the first day but I cannot remember his name...i spoke all three of them at one point. Everything was handled in such a professional but friendly way. So glad that I tried the Waynesboro location. Pick up and drop off were also painless and quick.

name: William Heard
text: Very good service by both Tom and Isaac. It could not have been better.

name: Kristen Ruusi
text: Over the July 4th holiday, I rented a Standard SUV to drive from Virginia to Michigan. When I made a last-minute decision to leave a day earlier, Enterprise was so accommodating and hooked me up with a car at an Enterprise closer to my office (with immediate pick-up). I was so happy to get the Infinity QX80 to drive with excellent vehicle handling, comfort and fuel efficiency. On my return trip, as I was taking an off ramp, I drove over something that caused a flat tire to both passenger side tires. After immediately calling Enterprise Roadside Service, a tow truck arrived to take me to the nearest airport.  From there I was able to get a replacement vehicle with no questions asked and get back on the road in no time!  Outstanding service, outstanding employees, outstanding experience every time!!!

name: Becky Matraw
text: Always great only thing is they upped the deposit that kinda sucks.

name: Scott Mulder
text: Always treated well here and they are very accommodating. Only thing I would improve is cleaning the cars better between customers - but that’s pretty much expected in the rental industry now days.

text: I reserved a compact car and at the last minute I had to changed my reservation for a bigger car. They obliged. Very friendly and helpful customer service.

name: Brandy Sanders
text:
I attempted to rent from this Enterprise twice. The first time, I didn’t realize that the deposit had increased to 200, thus I went to Budget to rent and got a cheaper renter for longer time. The second time, the gentleman at the desk meandered around talking about how he ‘forgot policies that they constantly change’. He grabbed some pamphlets and all before he attempted to help me.Then he stated he couldn’t take my business card due to it not having a chip. This location has been the most difficult one I’ve ever dealt with. Thankfully I got another car from budget, again!, for cheaper again. I’m disappointed because I am a enterprise plus member and have never been treated so poorly before.
It’s okay, I’ll keep using budget instead.

text: It's a storage unit, nothing fancy. The buildings are a little older than the competition near by. Every unit is on the ground floor and not intertwined in corridors and steps. Customer service was good and price same as most near by. The only reason I'm giving a 4 star is because the facilities could use a little TLC but nothing to worry about.

text: L what a delightful surprise in the middle of Williamsburg to find such a treasure as Anatolia restaurant! All the food is freshly prepared weed wholesome ingredients and homemade recipe and the prices are fair for what you get give it a try and let me know enjoy the atmosphere the ambience have the warm and friendly don't forget your wine!

text: Close to home.

Fair price ! Clean units.

text: They tried to discourage me from turning a tow behind stateing they only did trucks there, when i called them on it .....of course you can......

name: Karen Donnelly
text:
We stopped in on a recent trip to Wintergreen, a warm spring day.
The hostess essentially told us to try our luck elsewhere-the kitchen was slammed and they could not provide a waiting list. There were several open tables; we were willing to sit and drink for a good while but we were told  there was no telling when/ if food could be served. They were clearly overwhelmed.

name: Julie Stevens
text:
Wow. What a fantastic stop! I had the reuben which was amazing!!! Great taste and amazing sauce with some heat. The slaw was ok. I thought it could have had more flavor. The chips were delicious.
Seeing the chickens was so cool and the hospitality was top notch. I want to go back for dinner.

name: Mary Kouloubri
text: First family dinner out since COVID lock down. Great food and friendly staff

name: Valerie H
text: What a great place!  Bartenders were fast and friendly.  Nachos were good.  Beer was excellent!  Can't wait to go back!

name: Micah Stevens
text: It was a very nice day to sit and eat outside. The food was good, perhaps a little pricey. Really liked the beer.

name: Matthew Williams
text: Beer was decent, fish and chips very good, ribs so-so (not the place I would have expected to have great ribs, no disrespect to the chef). Service was excellent! They put us in the outer room area, which was a good move on their party, we are a rather raucous group! If you're there after dark, look for the creepy face being you!

name: Matt Postak
text: Gone here a few times and was decently pleased, though the last time we all ordered ribs...unfortunately they arrived hardly warm and honestly were underwhelming.  I expected better considering other dishes i've had in the past were pretty good.

name: Sue Wyatt
text: Everything is just a “little too”. Little too small of a menu – beer and food. Little too attention to service. Little too dry on the smoked chicken like it was a couple days old. Little too salty on the french fries. Little too wet on the coleslaw. Little too overcooked on the burger.  Nothing was too bad but it wasn’t too good either. And they do not allow tastes of alcoholic beverages before ordering “due to COVID”. No dishwasher?!?!

name: Mark C
text: Good and beer was good. Recommended small venue. Will be back!

name: Ian Trapp
text: Food was ok, not amazing. Beer was really good, and the place seemed very cool. Will definitely stop by again after a hike, especially post covid when I can enjoy the space more.

name: Jim Padowicz
text: Enjoyed the amber ale and excellent pulled pork BBQ!  Great staff!

resp.text: Thank you Jim!

name: Teresa Gunter
text: Wild Wolf’s fat and juicy hand-patted cheddar burgers are worth the visit. Especially when accompanied by a glass of amber goodness. And especially during the hour leading to twilight when the sun burnishes the leaves of the near mountain. We were encouraged by the attentive staff to linger over Rind It Up and Kolsch 151. Rind It Up finishes with a interesting and surprisingly unsweet flavor of melon. I’d love to have seen some of these ingredients whipped up into a gose.

resp.text: Thank you Teresa!

name: Cassandra Sims
text: Great beer. Good food. Good people. Nice place to come and visit. Definitely a must stop place when out that way!

name: Chris Dodson
text: I've eaten here and had a beer or two off and on for a year or so every time I come through. Most recently today for a post hike late lunch. The riblets and kolsch were on point for a cold wintery day. Good place.

name: Brek Sparks
text: Great staff, good beers, poor food value. Our 4th attempt here, as locals, and no progress. I understand that the menu has been truncated for efficiency and limited seating due to Covid, but at least make that smaller menu up to par. Charging $27 for 2 ribs, 1/4 cup of pork and a small 1/4 chicken was nuts. Not for 2 people as advertised. No WiFi to search for food options nearby if you don't like the menu, seems strategic. We won't give it a 5th attempt.

name: jay26tm
text: Love Wild Wolf. Interesting and spacious venue, great food, and good beer. The highlight was the knowledgeable,  accommodating, and extremely personable bartender we had. He made the visit so very enjoyable. Even though seating at the bar itself was closed (Covid 19 restrictions), there were enough individual tables in the bar area. Looking forward to going back!

name: Gena Mendola
text: My husband and I have been here several times and never been disappointed. The food is delicious and local. This is a great place to bring the family as well. There is lots of indoor and outdoor seating.

name: Michael Hearn
text:
Just like most restaurants and services, they have obviously been impacted by the ongoing pandemic.

Drinks and customer service were good. Nice and friendly hostess and waitress. Strong and tasty drinks. Food left a bit to be desired. Nachos were a bit bland, desert was decent. The burger I ordered was disappointing. Unfortunately they didn't have lettuce, tomatoes or pickles, and the cheese was a bit cold but did have onions and condiments at least.

At the end, they had to rerun our tickets 3 times since they kept mixing all of the orders up.

Will still go in for the tasty drinks though!

name: Jan Ward
text: Nice place, good beer and food.  The beer garden is really cool

name: Danny Rusbasan
text: Always great beers and dog friendly in the beer garden.

name: Paul Davies
text: This is a nice brewery,  but with current restrictions you cannot enjoy the place as you should. We ate inside and food was good, not great but good. I had fish and chips (french fries) and there were not many of them, fish was ok but again just ok, had better. Beer was good but again you cannot fully appreciate the place how you would want to. Had a better experience at brewing tree brewery down the road. May come back once restrictions are lifted.

name: kim fogle
text: It was an ok brewery. I thought the outside was cool and the food was good. The inside just had more of a bar feel than a brewery 🤷🏻‍♀️ Definitely check it out though! I’m sure if we had more time sitting outside would have been nice.

name: Valerie Smith
text: Food is delicious, Beer is great and service is outstanding!

name: Mark Lewis
text: Been to Wild Wolf a few times and I thought it was time to write a review. I have always enjoyed the food, beer and service, but I will describe when I was there last Saturday. My partner and I each had an appetizer. I had the chicken wings and she had the pretzel bites. The bites were nice and soft inside with a crisp outside from the fry. The cheese sauce was wonderful, probably could have had a shot of that by itself. The wings were spot on and had a flavor of pork on them. Loved the Buffalo sauce too. My partner loved her burger and was cooked pink like she requested. I had the Ruben and it lots of sauerkraut! Could have used a tad more thousand island dressing, but I loved it. The beer we had was a seasonal special called peaches be hazy. It was so good, we took three 6 packs home. Can’t wait for our next trip out to that part of the state.

name: Mindy Gholson
text: Love their Area 151 beer!!!  You can be seated to eat and drink or get a beer and find a place to sit outside.  Covid has really caused these places to change but their beer is still good!!!

name: Sanctuary Farm Everlasting Care
text:
Went here for the first time with my mother today for lunch. Our server, Kat, was top notch - knowledgeable, enthusiastic & fun without being over bearing. Her recommendations for food were great. The food itself was somewhat less than I expected quality wise for the hype - especially since they recently opened a Resturaunt in Charlottesville. The food was good - but just good, not great. Neither mom or I are beer drinkers & this biz is a brewery so certainly that's their focus. But they also promote their smoked meats & while I don't eat meat, mom said her reuben was "flavorful but the meat was tough". Mom is a lifelong corned beef eater & she said the quality of beef was less than she expected. Either that or their special smoking process actually made the beef tough not tender.

I had the fajita in a spinach wrap & it too was okay but way too heavy with cheese & neither the lime cilantro rice or corn & black bean salsa had any zing or fling but were rather dull & unmemorable. The "signature spicy ranch dip" was not spicy or unique - more like commercial ranch dressing with a little hot sauce in it. Even mom's special spiced fries were nominally spiced & not that special. The food was just okay but significantly over priced for how unremarkable it actually was.

We'll be going again and trying new dishes soon & will let you know if they do anything better than smoke tough meats or make bland dishes.

The server though, Kat made it worthwhile.

name: Angie Kelly
text: Food and service was great.  Loved the atmosphere. Dog friendly🥰

name: Ian Tatem
text: My wife and I had a wonderful anniversary experience on a perfect day out in Rockfish Valley! Thanks for making it truly memorable 🙂

resp.text: Thanks Ian!

name: Gary Henderson
text: If you like Beer, who doesn't,  you gotta stop in here and try the local selections. Always great folks and  wonderful  beer!

resp.text: Thank you Gary!

name: william helser
text: Beer and food was good. Service was awful. Placed an order for two and had to wait over an hour for food.

name: Misty Hall
text: Service was great, atmosphere could be improved

name: James Williams
text: 4/5 multiple visits. We stopped here a couple times over the years. I was more impressed the last time we stopped in the first. I haven't enjoyed many of their main line beers but some of the beers we got a chance to try at the brewery were much better in my opinion. I particularly liked the Four Paws and the Area 151. They have a large restaurant area that includes a large outdoor and a good-sized indoor eating area. On our last visit we had dinner at the brewery. The food was pretty good and the service was okay considering that it was a fairly large area. Considering the limited eating options in the area wild wolf actually might be one of the better choices you could make. I would recommend stopping here when you're in the area.

name: Josh Gonzalez
text: One of the best local breweries for drinks, food, and atmosphere. The beer selection has something for everyone and has a full-serving bar to please anyone. The food is incredible and you'll want to keep coming back to try the full menu. The atmosphere will make you want to spend a whole day and indulge in what they offer. Worth checking out and worth staying at.

name: Anthony Carr
text: Great beer.great food love the service ..worth the trip ..can't wait to go back

name: Becky Bergemann
text: My hubby loves Wild Wolf's blonde hunny ale! It's his absolute fav! So since they stopped canning and selling it (idk why) we HAD to get some to go while we were on vaca in this area. We didn't eat any food but the beer was good, as expected.

name: D farish
text: Good food and beers. Nice atmosphere and located close to other venues.

name: Susan Anderson
text:
Good food, good beer, beautiful laid back venue with awesome employees
I prefer the Czeched Out Pils and my husband likes the Blonde Hunny
Give them a try...you just might like it

name: Rick Adkins
text: Another good microbrewery that we stopped at for lunch so they have a pretty good menu also.  We did a small flight of 10 as a tasting and actually all the beers are good even though I'm not a fan of IPAs.

name: Mark Behnke
text: So they don't keep track of who walks up for a table, they make you sit down and say they will take you in order but never get your name, this leads to them taking 3 or more parties ahead of you who showed up after you did, beer is decent but don't believe their website for what they have at any given time, food is good when you finally get to it, overall the waiter and food/beer is worth it, but the host process is absolutely annoying, management needs to buy them a notepad to write down names

name: Gena S
text: Great place for people who love different beers. The food & service was awesome too!

name: Douglas Quackenbush
text: Great Belgium quad. Very good bbq. Covid sensitive. Great staff

name: lori huffman
text: Awesome gluten free options. Kat is the best server!

name: Jason Wells

name: Jimmy Lowe

name: Kirk Hicks

She was very attentive, even though she had several tables to handle around us., which made for a great experience outside under the oak trees. The entire staff did a great job with the new requirements during the Covid Pandemic, and this is coming from a germaphobe on a good day. We have been there multiple times in the past and will certainly be back. GREAT JOB SHAE and ALL OF THE STAFF!!!

name: Craig Cavanaugh
text: We're in phase 2 of the pandemic. The place was quite busy, the staff at a minimal,  but did an awesome job with what they had to work with. Food was delicious, and the staff was great. Will definitely go again 👍.

name: G E
text: The beer is average and the property is not very impressive.  You'll probably stop here because it is on the way to other things but there are better options in the area.

name: Glenn Rich

name: Kayla Driscoll

name: Benjamin Chartier
text: Good beer, super flavorful food. Even with covid they are doing well with outdoor seating. Worth a stop. Service was good. Smaller food serbings but still good

name: Curtis Tyler
text: Good beer, good food and good service. In a COVID-19 world they arent so full of themselves as to adopt every draconian measure ever suggested like the brewery down the street with initials DB, and I don't mean douche bags, although they do there darndest to prove they are. But I digress, Wild Wolf Brewing was a breath of fresh air after a quick backpacking trip with no mandatory reservation and a willingness to accommodate. I got the reuben with fries and it was very good, I also got a Primal Instinct pint and liked it enough the fill my growler with it.

resp.text: Thank you Curtis!

name: Lena Vandevander
text: Nice staff! Dog friendly! Great beer and food.

resp.text: Thank you Lena!

name: Dale Krumm
text: No service in the back outside seating area. No employee came out.

name: Tommy Kromer
text: If you're already in the area for Blue Mountain or Devils Backbone, this is worth hitting too.  Service was friendly, but slow.  Beer was good, but not great.  Food was fine, but not noteworthy.

name: Nip Melton

resp.text: Thanks so much!

name: jerry Lindsey
text: Food and service was great

name: Shelby Highsmith
text: Very good beer, good food, and the ample outdoor seating is nice. Smoking is apparently allowed on the patio, which is a bummer to be downwind from, but that's the price of covidtimes I guess.

name: Paul Phillips
text: Great place and beer

name: Em Dajc

name: Greg Wilber

name: Morgan Daly
text: Nothing exciting about this place. Obviously covid plays a part but nothing to mention about the service or the beer selection.

name: Douglas Hahn

resp.text: Thank you so much!

text: My wife got a flight and I got a beer that sounded good based on the description. The beer was alright, wasn't really too excited about any in the flight or the beer I was drinking. The place was packed and there wasn't any outside seating for us since we weren't getting food. The place itself looked like a cool place to hangout but the beer was disappointing.

name: joe tarpy
text: No beer flights, no samples of beer to try before purchase and pricey food.

name: Autumn Donski
text: Just go! And go hungry, not only is the beer great but the food is as well!!

resp.text: Thank you Autumn!!

name: Dana Fitzgerald
text: Great food and atmosphere

name: John Colvin
text: Kat was an outstanding server.  Early afternoon week day experience.  Orders of fish and chips, BBQ and turkey melt sandwich were all good.  Plan to go back again.  Enjoyed the area.

name: Chris Musick
text: Awesome beer, food and atmosphere!

resp.text: Thank you Chris!

name: Hollie
text: We arrived for lunch and put in our name for a table. It wasn't terribly busy but we were told it would be a 15 minute wait. It took much longer than 15 minutes but we were finally seated and given our menus. We waited for a while but a server never came to our table. We noticed that a couple who was seated when we first arrived still only had waters and no food. Other tables that were seated well before us also only had their drinks. At this point, the restaurant was only half full. We left, hungry and irritated. In total, we probably waited around an hour. This is absolutely unacceptable - we will absolutely avoid this place in the future and advise those wanting to actually eat in a timely manner to avoid it as well.

name: Lee Martin
text: Great beer, great service and great food!

name: Susanna Florance
text: Looked compelling from the road but once inside we were seated and no one ever waited on us so we got up and left. Only reason for two stars is the outdoor seating area had some atmosphere.

name: Bruce Grazier
text: Good food, beer and service

name: Michelle
text: Loved it! Beautiful day for the visit!

name: John G
text: I have never been happier with a place that I have eaten at. Their prime rib sandwich was amongst the best sandwiches I have ever eaten. Great election on beer and their staff was incredibly attentive and super friendly. Gluten free selections allowed all my family members to thoroughly enjoy they're great cooking. If you're within an hour of this place I highly suggest swinging in

name: Crystal Solomon
text: Excellent service, Reuben and smoked turkey sandwiches on par!! Our oysters were overcooked, which was quickly made up for with a free dessert (signature peanut butter pie). The oysters were served over fried green tomatoes, which were fried perfectly. Various seating options to suit anyone, dog friendly, outdoor smoking area, complete beverage list including Wild Wolf beers. Highly recommended.

name: Amie Holko
text: Great outdoor seating, which we didn’t utilize. We sat at the bar and ordered a couple drinks and the risotto balls. They were nothing special , we wouldn’t get them again. The beers were ok. The service was also just ok.

name: Joan Davis
text: We absolutely be love this place when we are in the area.  Super friendly staff, simple but quality menu.  Great beer!

name: Rob Phillips
text: A complete fail of your mission statement.  Took an hour for the kitchen to get half of the people in our party their meal.  After another 15 minutes the server was going to have the manager check on where the rest of the food was.  After another 15 minutes the manager had not come by to provide any update.  Restaurant was poorly staffed and not supported by their leadership.

name: Ricardo Rivera
text:
I will never understand the economics of the United States.
Going to a brewery in Los Angeles will set you back a pretty penny of course; and then you visit another brewery halfway across the country, and the beer costs the same.
I am so very intrigued at the way it all works.

name: Chip Grimes
text: We love Wild Wolf for the delicious beers, great food and top notch atmosphere. There is outdoor seating with a small play area for kids. Sometimes there is life music. They have a gift shop, fish pond, hops garden, a window to see them making fresh biscuits/breads and is located just outside Nellysford. Our kids beg to eat here whenever we're in the area, and we always oblige. Also very dog friendly and they sell beer by the growler/bottle/can for off site consumption.

name: Meredith Martinez
text: Not sure what everyone else is complaining about - because we had ZERO complaints! This place is super fun and has great food! Our service was AMAZING, everything was so fast and we felt well-taken care of. I wish I had asked what our waitress’s name was because she was just great. We sat outside in their adorable garden and enjoyed watching everyone’s puppies, the W.W. chickens, and the odd plane fly by. I had a flight of their 6 house-made beers and my husband & I shared their fried calamari. Fair warning: the calamari comes with bleu cheese crumbles if you’re not into that. But we loved them. Then I had their W.W. salad with some added pulled pork and my husband devoured his chicken melt sandwich. Their fries are perfectly crunchy but not too crispy, and well-seasoned. Their barbecue grilling in the back made the whole place smell sooooo smoky & delicious. We’ll definitely be back for more W.W. when we’re in the area again!

The beer choices were pretty good and I liked having so many IPAs to choose from.  Prices were standard with other local breweries.

name: Matt D
text: Very nice brewery with a couple of fairly out of the ordinary beers.  Really enjoyed my sampler and exploring what they have to offer.  I ordered a large pretzel that was very good.  I look forward to returning.

name: Brady Johnson
text: The vegetarian burrito was delicious! They have some of my favorite beers in the area! I highly recommend the Primal Instinct. It is a perfect blend of hoppiness and love. I would highly recommend this place to anyone coming into the 151 area.

name: Toni Starling
text: The food was ok

name: Paul D
text: Food is great. Beer is great. Service has always been great. Love the atmosphere. What a cool setup they have outside. I love having my beer and BBQ with a view of the mountains. No complaints.

name: Bruce Lowe
text: The first time I ever visited this place in 2015, the service was great and the food was spectacular! Now, two years later after menu changes in menus, and managers; my party and myself couldn't believe how quickly it's fallen. The food was cold, uncooked, had to be sent back more than more. The service was very slow and it wasn't even busy, barely any guest inside or outside.

name: Michael Brownley
text:
Beer was great - appetizer was a huge disappointment.  While tasty it was very, very meager for the price.  We've ordered the same type of appetizer in another restaurant and received at least three times the food for about the same price.
We've been here in Stoney Creek for over two years and the food started out great but has steadily gone down hill.  Prices have increased and food quality and quality have decreased.  I think the chef is  good but feel the dishes should in line with the cost.
It's a shame to have such a nice bar and restaurant in our back yard and then not want to eat there.  We used to enjoy taking out of town guests  for lunch and  dinner but now are hesitant.  I would love to see the food go back to what it used to be which was great..  Then maybe it would become our favorite local eatery again.

name: L Hoover
text: Plenty of tables were available in the outdoor seating area, over 50 percent free.  When I mentioned that we had two dogs with 2 people all of a sudden I was turned away and told that they were too busy.  I always enjoyed coming here with our dogs and had heard from others the service has really gone down the toilet and now personally experienced it. What a shame.

text:

Kimberly- I'm glad that you (the PAID MARKETING DIRECTOR) have been persuaded with a decent enough salary to defend Danny Wolf. I absolutely told the truth about this incident. Step down from your high horse and find a job working for decent people. I can't imagine what hell it must be to clean up after Danny all of the time.

This is my first 1 star review and it's well deserved.
I've never really had a problem with the service or food here (beer is sub par,) but that's not why I won't go back. I used to work for another brewery on 151 and on my days off I would go to the other local spots and show support my friends in the area. The last time I visited Wild Wolf, I was threatened by the owner's son with a knife while he accused me of stealing his beer recipes... I don't even drink their beer because it sucks. Staff was around the bar, but everyone was too scared of getting fired for telling Danny to stop. I stood up to him and even complained,  but when their mommy owns the place- there's no hope!

I stay away from their heated outside patio. It's dark, dusty, cheap furniture....and I haven't heard a decent band yet.. ..the music is just annoying,  and you have to yell over it. We arrived on Monday night 9/5 around 7:45 and were sat immediately by the host at a table outside - but then we just sat there and were ignored.  We sat there for 30 minutes (at least) -- then just got up and left.  We watched 3 servers chat with customers, clear tables and even sweep up... none of them came over to take our drink order.  It wasn't busy - I think there were only 3 other tables outside at the time.  We went back to Devils Backbone instead -- that place is great. I hope this review is helpful to encourage Wild Wolf to pay closer attention to their customers and put some emphasis on quality service.

name: Lucas Lyons
text:
Wild Wolf was my go-to brewery on the Brew Ridge Trail previously but that changed after a May 2016 visit.  The short--beer=good, food=overpriced.

Prices on meals rose 25% from our last visit a year before and portions were cut in half.  In particular, my wife got a 'large' salad that was little more than a small bed of bib lettuce, tomatoes, and bacon bits.  It was pitiful!  We're not big people.  This salad was not even enough to keep her full during a light hike after the meal and the cost was on par with restaurants in the middle of downtown Charlottesville.

I'm afraid that Wild Wolf, like some of our other old favorites in Central Virginia, has fallen victim to the misguided advice of some D.C. or Charlotte-based marketing firm full of overconfident 23 year-old's with newly-printed bachelor's degrees who come to Central VA throwing around buzz words like 'undervalued', 'contribution margin', and 'market segments,' with predictable results of pricing out locals who keep these restaurants going half the year.  $13.50 for half a sandwich with a bunch of chips on the side may seem like a deal on lunch break on K Street or in Times Square, but to the rest of us that smells like a giant rip-off.

The good though--beer!  Go drink their beer.

I was also appalled at the super thin sand paper (that tore at every seam and in between) that they expect people to use for toilet paper. Additionally, as a previous over the road professional truck driver, who has seen a plethora of downright nasty, or just less than decent restrooms, I have never been bombarded with so many flies and nats in any of them, as I was here! name: Elizabeth Hull
text: I remember when the mall had a lot of stores to choose from. About 5 years ago, there was a map of the mall with places like Ann Taylor, and other stores like that which have since moved out or gone out of business. I worked at one of the stores that went out of business and that store was new York and company. Things have since moved out- but that directory has stayed the same. I feel like when I was there and those stores were gone? That that made a lasting impression on if people walked to that area to see that it's gone and walk out, or find an alternative and stay. The map never really changed while I was there, and coming back on occasion- it never really changed after either.I feel like stores that would benefit the most, and would stay the longest would be kay and jared, sephora, the Starbucks kiosk, bare minerals, and a couple others,maybe the food court. The food court holds some places but not anything special that I would instantly go for. I do like the japanese and the Chinese food there.. the Chick-fil-A is a little too expensive for my taste. ( no pun intended.) But going there, compared to when the stores there were more prominent.. is just an average experience. I feel like malls are starting to lose their sparkle because of online sales, and being that its quicker for some people- online is where they would go instead of being in a box store. Working in retail for a number of years has taught me some lessons from the store to online and what differences it holds. It's sad to see it slowly but surely diminish.. but as they say " let it go its course". 😔

I asked if I could please have a cup of water. She says “we have bottled water and that’s all we have.” In a very rude tone. I understand that’s a policy and that’s not her fault but there was no need to get rude. After getting our popcorn and drinks, she never once said thank you or even made an effort to be pleasant. I work in customer service and there’s no excuse for acting like that.
