Other than the sound system it was a good experience.

name: Mary
text: Large, clean theater. Kind and helpful staff. They have recently started the reserved seating that other theaters are doing, and despite complaints, I love it. It makes it easy for me to take my group of ten to the theater and all be able to sit together. Rates for pretty much everything are a bit pricey, but that's the case everywhere so I won't fault them for that. They also have a kiosk for picking up tickets if you reserved earlier, making it quick to jump the line and get through. And they accept movie pass!

name: Drew Burch
text: I feel like this theater has the best screens compared to anywhere between waynesboro to roanoke. The staff is great and the owner is very people friendly and social media involved which allows others to know what special events are going on.  The only reason I gave 4 out of 5 stars is I wish they had more combo varieties and possibly if they could tweak the rewards program. I had a rewards membership amd used it quite often but never seemed to be able to redeem anything. Other than that, this really is a great family theater and I come here as often as I can even though we live an hour away.

name: Kristina Bliss
text:
Zeus is a clean and comfortable theater. Movie volume and room temperature are just right. There is a lounge with couches for "people-watching" if you find that more interesting than previews. I often have my dog in the vehicle and there is a spacious grassy hill to the West of the parking lot where I can let him out to run around before and after the movie.

I never eat or drink movie concessions, so I cannot review that.

The employees are always different every time I visit this theater. Not sure what is the deal with such high turn over. They are generally nice, however, even while it seems like perpetual trainee scene.

Almost loses a star for assigned seating. I like to intuit where I want to sit after I go in. I guess it is a necessary evil to accomodate internet ticket sales.

When I visited there last I experimented in the little arcade. It had a very scary 1st person crossbow action shooter game with realistic and extremely gory (attacking zombies so ok?) violence and life-like horror. I really enjoyed that game, better than Target Terror (I dropped an extra $5 at Zeus destroying the undead...and well, also getting killed by them!) I am sure the kids dig the arcade too. But it was mostly adults like me in the arcade when I was there. I saw a few people playing the basketball game (shooting hoops, not a video game) and laughing together hysterically.

It seems that many people find that Zeus is an entertaining venue.

text: Drove past this place on the way to our daughter's place, and decided to give it a try. Loved all of it! The whole package! Yeah so the place isn't a fine dining establishment, but it's perfect for what it is. The pulled pork sandwich with potato salad and baked beans was amazing! Also tried the slaw that my husband had and it was amazing too! We were promptly served our food and we ate right there in shop. Loved the atmosphere. name: Sean Crook
text:
Can't beat this meat! Rustic and eclectic, Blue Ridge Pig has stood the test of time as the best BBQ in Nelson. Even John Goodman is a regular. Customers can be described as migrant workers to millionaires.

"Strawberry" the owner, has been featured in multiple publications for his vinegar based pork and unique smoking method. If you're lucky, he'll invite you out back to see where the magic happens in the smoke room. The aromas invite and entice.

Baked beans are sweet and savory, challenging your taste buds. Potato salad is tossed with in a special dill sauce. Ribs and turkey croissants are a treat. Nothing will disappoint. The fulfilling flavors will stay with you on your trip up to Wintergreen or back home.

I'd say it was anything but that.

For lunch, you can have a sandwich or you can have a sandwich.  The Pork BBQ sandwich was just so-so.  Nothing to really write home about.  Bread was burnt and crumbled when you took a bite.

It also took forever for us to get our sandwich.  Not sure what the delay was since it wasn't that busy. At least 30 min of wait for their signature Pork BBQ sandwich which you'd expect they'd be able to put together in few minutes.

If you are curious about this place, my recommendation is to skip it and drive on.

Maynard

The menu is vast, as most Mexican restaurants are, but nothing spectacular jumped out at either of us. Added a star for good service.

text:
I work at the mall and today is June 4. For Mall employees if you order on the mobile app, you receive a free dessert. I’d add a photo to this review if I could. I called from my store and asked how I should go about that, as I work until the mall closes. The person told me they are the shift leader and they are unaware of this promotion for mall employees. They were TOTALLY unhelpful and did not even try to accommodate me even when I told them I can show them the flyer.

He told me there’s only one manager and he doesn’t work until Wednesday. I am off the rest of the week as I just pick up shifts. I’m not driving out here just for that but I am upset that I am staring at a flyer distributed by the mall and Chick-fil-A cannot even follow through.

I asked if he could call the manager and he seemed reluctant to do so. I’ve worked in the mall over a year, and over 10 years ago my first job was at a Chick-fil-A. We always stood out because we went the extra mile.

That was not done today. I won’t spend any more money at this location since it is clear my service isn’t valued and it wasn’t wanted because I ended up not ordering my dinner tonight.

Just a suggestion, next time, give the free dessert and follow up with your manager later so you don’t end up with 1 star and unhappy customers.

text: I work within the mall and normally eat at this restaurant 1-2 times a week.  My experience has been pleasant for some time.  I can normally order within the app and pickup at the store easily!  That said, I had a poor recent experience.  I attempted to make an order for this store using the Chick-Fil-A app.  I received an error message advising me to see a team member.   I spoke with a team member upon arrival and they had not received my order.  The next day I saw a charge pending for the failed order as well as my new order.  I reached out to Chick-Fil-A cares and was promised someone would check the issue out and follow up with me.  Later that day the store Manager, Jared Bryant, contacted me and left a message.  It was late that night and because it was a Saturday, I followed up on the Monday.  Mr. Bryant collected some information and advised he would follow up with me on Wednesday.  To this day I have not heard from Mr. Bryant.  I sent an email to Chick-Fil-a on the Friday after.  I have not had any follow-up from Chick-Fil-A.  As of right now, this company has stolen money from me and not attempted to make any effort to rectify the situation.  I would strongly recommend one of the other restaurants in the mall and to avoid using the Chick-Fil-A app.

name: Anthony Prisco
text:
As soon as you open the door the delightful smell of fresh baked bread and tasty treats will grab you.  Everything is made fresh on the premises, and it is as visually inviting as it is stimulating to your senses.

From delicious samples to the wonderful employees, this place is truly exceptional. The young lady who so graciously assembled my sandwich had a smile that could light up a room.

I had the Mediterranean Sandwich on classic white, did I mention the bread was fresh baked. The sandwich was a delight and my palette has yet to recover.

I encourage anyone who is looking for an alternative to fast food to try Smith & Clarkson Deli, you will not be disappointed.

This was one of the best customer experiences I have had in quite some time.

text: We ate here yesterday (well we carried out from here really). I had the rooster club. It was huge and delicious. My wife had the Ruben and it was the best Ruben she has had. Nice lean thin sliced corn beef served the cheese in the bottom and sauerkraut on top so it didn’t Hager soggy. Nicely done. We will certainly be back.

text:
Just what we were looking for, food was delish, staff was so kind, we will 100% be back!

We ordered the Turkey sandwich on a bagel, western omelet, and blueberry pancake. All were  wonderful, the bagel itself was extra on point!

When one of the ladies heard it was our first time there she brought us some chicken tenders with their homemade sauces. So good, certainly a must try!!

text:
I had the bulgogi wrap which seems like a non-typical entree for a place like this; it was delicious though.

I've been back 2 times since. I had the chicken tenders with the spicy Korean sauce and the soy garlic sauce on the side. These were excellent and extremely fresh.

The 3rd visit I had the spicy chicken sandwich which was a new item. They use a bread and butter pickle and a ranch sauce on it. The combination with the freshly fried chicken is amazing. My wife also had the chocolate chip pancakes and they were great!

Everything here is freshly prepared. The fried chicken is some of the best I've had in awhile and is as close to homemade you can get without actually making it yourself.

I'm convinced that this is the best restaurant in Burke. If you haven't tried this gem, please do yourself a favor..

They are definitely a go to place now.....better than IHOP in terms of their waffles especially... And their chicken tenders are what they are supposed to be. text: Smith & Clarkson's Cafe was a great choice for a quick in and out lunch.  The place wasn't crowded.  The staff was attentive and provided good service.  The food was made and delivered to the table quickly. Each person in my party thought the food was tasty and worth the value.

I got a veggie wrap with fries and an Earl Grey. The wrap is tasty and my fries were somewhat dry, but not beyond a redeeming pool of ketchup.

The dinning room wasn't overcrowded although I could not get wireless connection.

I recommend trying out this hidden gem for breakfast or lunch. I plan to return for pancakes.

I admit I don't have much experience with the place. But with the margaritas and prices and accommodating us during non happy hours, I'm giving 5 stars because I see no room to improve in those areas.
If I try them again, I'll give an update.

name: Rodger Gettler
text: I've dined here with my girlfriend twice in the last month, and both times we were highly impressed with the experience. the food was much better than the typical Mexican restaurant in the Mid-Atlantic area. Slightly more expensive, just slightly, but also worth it IMO. Last time I had the pork ribs with white rice, steamed broccoli medley, and black beans. the Ribs were AWESOME! Really. Not quite like any others I've had, with a unique sauce. My girlfriend had the Salmon, again. She liked it just as much the second time. I had my standard Chicken Enchiladas, rice and re-fried beans last time, and it was very good, but after seeing the girlfriends Salmon plate, I decided to try changing out of my Mexican rut. service has been good both times. Atmosphere is good, albeit smaller inside, nice outside if weather permits...

name: Vishal Sinha
text:
We stopped by Los Tios Grill the other day when we were in the neighborhood. We had our hopes set high based on all the positive reviews. The place was packed and we were lucky to get one of the last few empty tables.

The waitstaff was prompt and friendly, which always makes the experience better. The salsa was good and had a kick to it.

I ordered the steak fajitas. The flavor on the meat was very good but the meat was quite chewy which totally downgraded the experience.

Others in the group too had mixed reviews of their dishes.

Need to come back here one more time and give this place another shot.

name: Peter Thaggard
text:
We love the food, the staff, and the ambiance at Los Tios.  While they have all of the "usual suspects" for a Mexican restaurant, they also have Ecuadoran entrees and some infrequently-seen Mexican entrees.  I especially enjoy their seafood entrees, which are similar to Paella but with a Latin American twist.
During Virginia's few low-humidity/lower-heat months such as March, April, October, and November, I recommend that you take advantage of their plentiful outside seating.

name: Chris Hennen
text:
The same quality of "Mexican" as any local Chili's at a higher price.
Very few other restaurants in the area are as disappointing in quality and safety as Los Tios.  The food is reliably disappointing and bland with low quality ingredients (greasy, oily cheeses, and beans).
Their service is slow and often orders are incorrect when brought out.
Being this mediocre does have its advantages though; they were the only restaurant in the area on a first Friday that could seat a table for 9 with no notice or wait, just like what one would expect from a Taco Bell.

text: Only 4 stars because of the service otherwise would have been 3 stars.  Been going here for years and well before expansion and getting proper venting from the kitchen. Disappointed from the food aspect. Free salsa....much too watery and bland although chips...hot and fresh. 2 of us went for various combinations of chicken, beef and chorizo fajitas while 1 went for beef burrito. Used to be pretty darn fast but we waited a long time in a half empty place for food to be delivered. Fajitas came with gristly beef, bland chorizo but well spiced chicken. Peppers and onions appeared they had just been thrown on the metal serving plate and onions not even translucent. Accompaniments to fajitas were very small serving sizes and beans, although I like the style, were lukewarm and/or cold. The burrito had been downsized from previous visits. A word of advice to the restaurant if a downturn in this restaurant's vision in the face of increasing competition in the downtown area would be to double down on making fresh, delicious dishes and not give up by serving inferior food or hiring inferior chefs especially at Market Station.

text:
Great Food, but Pricing and Portions Vary --

I always go at lunchtime (noon) and order the same thing: beef chimichangas and it always comes with the exact same size chimichanga. The issue is that sometimes the price is $10.95 (lunch) and sometimes it's 11.95 (the dinner price). I've mentioned that and they say that is what I ordered (I always say the lunch special). Sometimes it comes with guacamole and sometimes it doesn't. Usually if I mention it, they bring out a small portion. TODAY, they charged me $7 for a full serving of guacamole and stated that the item never comes with guac. Some consistency could go a LONG way. I'm giving you all three stars because the food is always amazing. The inconsistency is driving me away from your business and I'm furious that I paid $20 for a $12 lunch today (and that's not counting the tip I left).

name: Thomas Stevenson
text:
Due to some flooding and damage to our house, we were relocated by our insurance company to the Residence Inn Fairfax City. We have been staying at the hotel for almost two months at this point and love it.

We are staying in the one bedroom suite and, while it's not home, it's very comfortable for what it is. The only thing the kitchen is missing is an oven, which I assume is due to fire code. The cookware is limited but sufficient. The couch and armchair are comfortable and clean. The desk/TV stand is functional, though it's placement makes opening the window a balancing act. The bed is wonderful, as is the bathroom.

The cleaning service is very good. I understand they will also launder your clothes for a small fee and do your grocery shopping. We have not taken advantage of that however, only because we prefer to do it ourselves. The reception staff are very friendly and helpful.

The best thing about this hotel is their pet-friendly policy. We love being able to have our dog with us.

My only complaints are for stupid First World problems:
- If the trashcan liners were any thinner, they would be non-existent. I have never NOT ripped one.
- The light fixture next to the bed CAN be controlled by the switch near the door, but if you turn the switch off, the power outlet on the base of the fixture no longer functions. So if you want to use that outlet to charge your phone, you have to leave the switch on and manually turn on/off the light.
- The Internet gets abysmally slow during peak hours, wired or WiFi.
- The dishwasher kind of sucks.

Sat down and both my sandwich and hash browns were cold!  This restaurant severely lacks basic management/leadership.

Mark - Stafford, VA

name: Abdullah Elamari
text: Overall pretty disappointing, especially with an established reputation such as the Westin and for the price you pay a night. Rooms are nice and spacious, but the two chairs are very uncomfortable. And regarding the bed, the mattress is comfortable, but the pillows were horrendous! You might as well sleep without one on the mattress. The sheets and covers were also uncomfortable and every time I turned my skin would burn against it, I barely got 4 hours of sleep. Rooms aren't really well insulated, you can hear a lot of things from the hallway: doors opening/closing, people chatting, cleaning service chatting, vacuuming, banging. Also, service was below average for such a place: I was deliberately lied to by the employee when making a reservation. I was told there was still 24 h room service (their website also states this) when I asked to confirm he said it is indeed true, lo and behold! I arrive after 10 pm hungry and they have nothing and only 7/11 2 blocks down is open (yuck!) Very unprofessional. Honestly, location is decent if you have something you need done in the area for a couple nights, but I recommend looking at other places, especially for the price point. What a joke.

name: Matt Aldred
text: This is a very clean and well appointed hotel. The staff is friendly and helpful. On our last visit we arrived in the afternoon for check-in. We were told our suite was not ready yet due to cleaning. We patiently waited but when the front desk clerk could see I was getting a little antsy she made a call, without me asking, and then let me know they would be moving me to different suite so we wouldn't have to wait any longer. I understand that cleaning issues cannot be helped due to previous guest issues and appreciated that they did not want my family to wait longer than necessary. Also, they moved us up to higher floor for better view!

name: William Hinson
text: Clean, comfortable, and modern. Employees are friendly and helpful making this a great place to stay. I will give 5 star when they start serving breakfast again.

name: M D
text: Nice hotel, the only issue is they don’t serve breakfast and the hotel suites don’t have microwaves in case you carry some food for the next morning when you’re busy working from the suite itself. Hope you guys update that, one more thing I got offended last night getting to my suite and the front desk rudely stopped and questioned me even though I was walking in after 3 other guys that he didn’t seem to be bothered by their presence!!!! Hey sir business people come in different shapes and colors not just one ethnicity.

name: Yani kimani
text: Hotel is very nice and convenient. However, I am a titanium member and my room was dirty and I woke up with red eyes. The air quality is very dry and room definitely needs to be updated. I requested a suite and it was unavailable.  I won't be staying here again. The first time I stayed was last year and it was nicer. Not sure what happened here. But I hope they get it together. COVID-19 or not

text:
Room was great and beds very comfortable.  Microfiche large size.
However, parking garage is confusing and hotel front desk staff not clear on instructions how to exit as a guest or give you an exit card because the lanes are extremely narrow.  I drove my half ton pickup and could barely maneuver in it.  Top of canopy scraped the height bar at a mismarked 7 ft.

name: Thomas Morrow
text: Cards demagnetized, had to flush toilet using flapper, the rate included breakfast buffet with terrible service (only filled up water at beginning and didn't see again) the first time I've ever just walked out of a restaurant without really seeing staff? The food was pretty decent with the breakfast Staples and fresh fruit, the front desk staff was really nice. The valet was a little weird-we wanted to check in and then drive out for dinner-parked where they asked (not convenient there is no temp parking when you check in) then they asked to hold they keys while we checked in, then 10 minutes later didn't remember us giving the keys. All in all the whole ONE night was below average with a few hassles. The 2 stars are for the room (minus the toilet) and the front desk staff. Any of these issues alone wouldn't be bothersome but it just seemed to really add up when we're on the grounds less than ten hours.

text:

text: Modern and nice layout. Great for professional events. Would recommend to any company looking to schedule a town hall etc. Central to most public transportation options.

name: Michael Baird
text: Really like this place. Clean. Friendly helpful staff. And the facility it self I great. Not to mention all the shops and restaurants all next to it. Love it.

name: Curvaceous Gods
text: Went for a Christmas Party for work. Amazing friendly staff! Everyone was very nice and made sure everything was taken care of.

name: Mume Batt
text: An awesome hotel with excellent service.

name: Redwan Mohammed
text: Wow very nice location cool area & they r familiar

name: Jessee C
text: This is a quiet hotel in the heart of the Ballston neighborhood in Arlington. The staff at the front desk are kind. Both check in and check out were quick. My room was clean, but there was some obvious wear-and-tear on the doors. Not a deal breaker by any means, but not the most attractive either. Best feature ls in the room were the huge windows and the outlets in the base of the side table lamp. Those were quite helpful. There area of improvement would be that parking was only valet and it cost $29 per night. Overall, this hotel is a 4 out of 5 stars.

name: Jericho McLeod
text:
I had issues with my stay here. My online reservation went through just fine, but on check-in I was told there was a $75 deposit for incidentals that would be held on my card. No problem, I give them my card, and a $114 charge shows up. It isn't terrible, but I wasn't given accurate information about a hold or charge to my card.

Further, personalized service was requested an not received. I also brought a blanket from home (that happened to be a similar color as the ones in the room, but it was electric), which house keeping took.

name: Brandy Bryan
text: The hotel was beautiful. The staff was helpful and friendly. The room was very nice and the bread was firm. I did ask for extra towels and extra pillows which they confirmed when I checked in, but we're not in the room.

name: Sikali Dr
text: Can't tell much. Was there for s party. Looks like guess who want to be inside the city should consider this option.

name: James Coles III
text: The hotel is nice, the price for the weekend and the location is excellent! Check in and check out was easy and quick. Even though we didn't get a chance to use the pool and weight room it was there at our disposal. The only negative I have for this hotel is that parking is $30 over night. Personally, I feel shouldn't have to that much for parking but other than that. 4.5 for me. Fyi they have a Starbucks inside the hotel for all my coffee heads

name: Bill Jacobi
text: Good business hotel. Clean, efficient staff, good amenities. Short walk to the Metro and in the heart of Ballston. If you forget your runners, the hotel will supply you with a what appeared to be new, spare pair.

name: Native Cheif
text: Great piece nice and clean good service. I would have given five stars but while we were there the hallways smelled horrid the entire time and they did not fix it

text: Everything's perfect except the $32 a day parking fee.

name: Yulia Lama
text: Professional staff and very good vibes.

text: Westin has nice clean rooms, friendly staff, and great food. The view from the rooms is also great. I prefer Westin over any other hotel chain.

name: Mark B.
text: Ok location in Ballston but poor service.

name: Jonathan Collum
text: I was here for a conference.  The meeting spaces were pretty standard fare.  It is conveniently located in Ballston with many parking options and a number of good food options around.  The food on sight was great as well at the breakfast and evening receptions that we had.

name: donn westerhoff
text: Great hotel, great service, good location.  Only issue--if you are a contractor you are not offered appropriate governments rates.   Westin clearly does not understand that govt contractors are bound BY CONTRACT to travel using GSA per diem and lodging rates.

name: Lorenzo Coplin

name: Matthew
text: Very nice hotel in a great location.  Customer  service was good.  Rooms are very clean and as usual the beds are superb!

name: Richard Plocica
text: We were there for a  SAT dinner dance and stayed overnight. Partied a lot so we slept thru breakfast--so no other meals rated. Food, service, DJ, decorations and drinks were great! Westin catering is really superb. We have stopped in at their Starbucks and Pimini for drinks..all were great. Nice decor..the rooms and elevators and public restrooms were neat, orderly, clean and well maintained with nice decor and features for charging phones as well as a nice sized fridge and coffee service. We slept really well and felt fully rested.

name: Jimmy G
text: Friendly and professional staff, smooth check-in, close to plenty of fresh eats, short walk to the metro. Not too shabby, if I do say so myself!

text: Don't think I would ever book a reservation here, just to talk on them on the phone I am put on hold for over 30minutes, just to ask a simple question. Front Desk just sends me to another person, which may of be more of service, but then he tells me call him back in a hour. I wait a hour I call him back no answer keeps ringing and ringing and ringing. Then front desk picks up the phone and puts me on hold. Im still on hold even when writing this review to analyze their phone services. I am rational ,but the wait time is ridiculous.

Will look elsewhere next time i am in Arlington which is often. I have stayed in better Westin properties.

text: Have to be fair here, the pet policy is very affordable and they have a very welcoming staff. However, 2 or possible 3 negative things about this place. 1 the parking garage is so small and confusing to navigate through. Second, the service at the Amuse Bar was horrendously slow. I spent about 30 mins in line the first day and almost 45 minutes the second day just waiting to put in my order. But with COVID I will say maybe they just were not prepared. Lastly, the room had no microwave, no fridge, and AC/Heat unit is extremely loud. Overall the stay was pleasant but took some getting used to here and there in respect to the room and the  food service.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. While we are happy that you enjoyed our staff and had an overall pleasant stay, we are disappointed to hear of the issues you encountered with parking, Amuse and your guestroom. We will be addressing your comments regarding the delayed service in Amuse and your other concerns with our team in an effort to improve our overall guest experience. We hope to welcome you back again for a more enjoyable visit!

name: Mahmood Bitar
text: Staff was beyond helpful and friendly. Location is superb. The building and rooms are fresh and clean. Parking is NOT a huge deal. There is a garage that you can pay for or opt for on street parking. There is plenty of street parking (and its free after 8PM).

name: Kristin Cairns
text: Very pleasant 1-night stay @ Le Méridien. Convenient location (1 minute from metro, 15 minutes by foot to Georgetown). The rooms were well-appointed, impeccably clean and comfortable. The service was outstanding. Many thanks to Carlos, at the front desk, for being receptive to my room preferences and calling after check-in to ensure I was satisfied with my room. Leilani was also very helpful and Douglas has got to be, hands down, the friendliest barman in VA and D.C. I can't wait to come back!

name: Son Shyne
text:
We booked this hotel for my husband’s cousin wedding.

Appearance: First, the hotel is beautiful. That can’t be denied.  Very modern and pretty inside.
Parking: You will have to pay for parking. Spoiler alert: it’s expensive. Saturday night parking was 20-25 bucks and Sunday was $40.

Staff: Front desk staff was very nice and helpful.  It was concerning that no one made mention of the security deposit that was being held from my card. Bartenders ( female on Friday night and male on Saturday night) were awesome.

Food/ Bar:  Bar prices were pricey for what I’m use to paying. The kicker is that my husband paid $10 dollars for a bottle of water from the bar. You read it right. I was expecting a bottle of Dasani or something. Nope. They pulled out a blue glass bottle of distilled water and told us the price.  There is no vending machines on site that I saw and the closet store was a bit of a walk so we had no choice but to buy it.

Room: The bedroom was nice as far as cleanliness goes but I expected more from a four star hotel. There was no microwave or refrigerator in the room which was super inconvenient.
The bed was absolutely horrible. There were HUGE dips in the bed. It made getting a good night sleep absolutely impossible. When I was able to fall asleep, I woke up with the worst back pain.
The walls seemed a bit thin. I could definitely hear a couple arguing about what time they needed to meet someone for dinner.
Overall, it’s a nice hotel with some great views but I don’t see myself recommending it to friends or family. Everything is super expensive and not told up front.

name: Mike Scherzer
text: Love this property, have stayed here on two occasions.

name: Vivek Chulani
text:
We had our wedding reception here and to fully describe our experience it's best to break it up into pros and cons:

Pros: The hotel gave discounted room rates for individuals who were attending the wedding. Karen, the event coordinator, was a joy to work with. She stayed on top of things and tried to accommodate all our requests and needs even on the day of. The Amuse restaurant was dimly lit and has great views of gerogetown in the night which also provides for great pictures. The head chef was also a delight to work with as we provided him recipes prior to the tasting and he added a spin to each and they were all delicious. The appetizers especially the shrimp turned out to be fantastic! He also went ahead and did a peacock fruit display for the cocktail hour which looked really cool! The bartenders at the open bar were pretty active and friendly with all the guests. They also threw in the honeymoon suite for two days which was a treat.

Cons: Aleecya, the sales personnel, was a nightmare to work with. It seems her answer to every question is Yes and she has no clue about anything that goes on. There were breakdowns after the contract was signed due to ignorance and negligence on her part. She operated very unprofessionally. She also never replies to emails nor phone calls. The hotel also does not have coffee makers within their rooms so we provided small coffee makers to each room that guests were staying in. The hotel tried to make up for this by providing daily vouchers for coffee. We also provided the hotel with welcome boxes to be placed in the guests room prior to them arriving, however, only a few guests received it and I had to be following up with them everyday to ensure it was done. Sadly, we had to take a few boxes back and hand them out ourselves. During the reception, people in the kitchen were cursing and making loud noises while individuals were making speeches and my dad had to go back there and tell them to shut the **** up. This was probably the most disappointing highlight and would think people would be more professional and courteous.

name: Tim Dolan
text:
Nice hotel. Convenient location. Clean with great amenities.  Knocking off two stars. One because the entrance to the hotel is a royal pain in the a$$. Street level, no bellhop, up an elevator to front desk, then up a second elevator to your room. Toting my luggage the whole way. Not the end of the world, but not what I would expect of a hotel of this price point and level.  Second star gets knocked off due to opting to go "eco friendly" for a week to accumulate extra SPG points and then never receiving the points. I don't think this needs to be a two star review, however further solidifying my disappointment was my upgraded "city view" room consisted of staring at a concrete wall out one window, and directly into the adjacent office building through the other.

Staff was friendly, and the dry cleaning services were up to snuff. Room service was so-so.

All in all, uninspired and a little disappointed.

name: Shadonna Reed
text: I loved it !

name: smitty smith
text: The headboards are gross but the. Service and staff is almost unbeatable. Definalty a 5 star hotel

name: 3nfinity777 4Eva
text: BEWARE!!! My Reviews are Mysteriously Being Removed. The "General Manager" Hazel is spiteful and vindictive. Yesterday, I left an unfavorable review. Directly after that my card was charged $106. Today, I called Le'Meridian to inquire about the charge. Hazel the "General Manager" informed me that I was charged a cleaning fee, I asked her what for? Hazel stated that housekeeping had to clean up blood in the room. I asked her why wasn't I contacted in regards to this matter before my card was charged? I never received an answer to that question from Hazel. Then, I asked her how can you definintivley determine that what you thought you saw was in fact blood? Do you have a degree in forensic science? Hazel stated that as the "General Manager" she has had biohazard training, REALLY??? I am appalled and offended at Hazel's inaccurate conclusion. Does biohazard training give Hazel permission to accuse without inquiry? How does Hazel know what she that she saw was indeed blood without adequate testing? It seems as if Hazel might be in the wrong profession. As Le'Meridian's "General Manager" Hazel needs more training in resolution and communication. Her overconfidence is distateful and disdainful. This is my second unfavorable review in regard to her unproffesionlism. In the mist of the pandemic that we are all in, unwarranted accusations are never acceptable or appreciated. My husband and I will definitely not be returning to Le'Meridian. We have warned our friends and family not to patronize this hotel from this point on. Le'Meridian has their "General Manager" Hazel to thank for the loss of business.

resp.text:
Hello 3nity777 4Ever,
I am sorry to hear about your experience and disappointed that we failed to meet your expectations during your most recent visit. We pride ourselves on providing every guest with friendly service and a clean, well maintained room.

I value every guest experience and strive to run an operation of integrity and transparency. We rarely charge extra cleaning fees as cleaning is what we do on a daily basis, and it is expected. Unfortunately, the condition in which your room was left required special attention. The health and safety of our guests and associates are our top priority. We have taken extreme measures to ensure that every room is properly sanitized and cleaned to our standards, especially during this unprecedented time.

I truly appreciate you staying with us and hope that you will give us another opportunity in the future. Thank you for your feedback and please feel free to contact me personally at 703-351-9170 should you have any questions.

Sincerely,

Hazel

name: Carla Rothmann
text: This is a pretty, modern hotel on the Potomac. The room was clean and had a nice view of the river. Easy walking distance to sights and food. Only not 5 stars because the food in the restaurant wasn't quite as good as the price would suggest.

name: Sturg E
text: Haven't stayed in the rooms so can't speak to those, but the bar is a cool spot for happy hour.

name: tana santiago
text: Great location. Really nice spacious room very modern. Very quiet with super comfy beds i will most definitely stay again. The staff was very helpful and attentive

name: Ben Mendis
text: The hotel is beautiful and had an interesting layout. There are some great views to be had from their balcony on the fourth floor. Great wedding venue. Luxurious looking suites. Friendly and accommodating staff. Everyone was knowledgeable and had a smile.

name: Mary Unegbu
text: I absolutely enjoyed my stay at this hotel. It is very clean and the rooms are huge and well spaced/ structured. Customer service was very nice and the hotel is not too far from the DC airport. I do wish they had a shuttle that picked people up from the airport. Also, I wish they had somebody on the ground floor main lobby checking people in and not having people take the elevator to the fourth floor before getting to see anyone that can help with checking in. Otherwise, I would definitely recommend.

name: Bill Fisher
text:
Rooms are pretty small, had to be escorted to my room because the key card system was down when I checked in, couldnt log onto internet...  Overall, not a typical Le Meridien experience.  Location is good, hotel otherwise seems nice, but I doubt I would stay here again - tons of better Marriott-branded properties in the Arlington / Rosslyn area.

Update:  key card system is still down this AM, only one person working the front desk, been waiting 15 minutes for someone to show up for escort to room.  This experience is just getting worse by the minute.

name: G Aquino
text:
The building and facilities look new and modern. We were allowed an early check-in and the room was clean and well-appointed. The hotel is just a 5-minute walk to the nearest metro station (Rosslyn), with three train lines to downtown DC. The staff we encountered was mostly pleasant and helpful.

A few things we didn't like:

The photo of the outdoor deck with a view of DC, as posted by the hotel here on Maps, is not accessible to guests. They also posted photos of rooms with the same view, but upon check-in, the staff told us they didn't have such rooms. Our room did have a partial, teeny tiny view of the Washington Memorial, but most of what you see is an army of buildings that obstruct the view.

Most people don't mind finding a bible or religious book at the bedside table. I do.

name: Lisa Carter
text: I wish like many others there was an option for no star to express their not so good experience. I called directly to the hotel located in George Town and the phone was hung up 2 different times with conversation in noise in the background and the 3rd time the gentleman and did not acknowledg himself nor the hotel that I was calling nor did he acts how can I help me. "hello" he says I then requested if you can confirm a reservation for me. He says "when you come in" I gave him the dates and then he acts for my last name. He was very dry as he stated nothing" and then I gave him a nother last name and the conversation and phone call quickly ended with me saying" OK thank you and he silently hung the phone up. So unlike the Marriott so rude so unacceptable

name: A. Thomas Grunley
text: While we only enjoyed cocktails here (we did not spend the night nor did we see a guest room), in general the hotel was a nice little surprise out of nowhere in Roslyn. The drinks were poured tall but pretty expensive. Modern decor was present throughout the lobbies and other common spaces.

name: Kevin M
text: Rooms were very nice and clean. Parking available for a decent rate. Free wifi which you don't often find at hotels such as these. Would gladly go again.

name: Joan Jolly
text: Beautiful

name: Hanyang Xu
text: Hotel is a very presentable experience and staff are a class act. Work well under pressure and always polite and friendly. Never of the drinks here have been missteps. The appetizers can be slightly subpar, even for happy hour prices, but are not unpleasant.

name: Haleigh X
text: I thoroughly enjoyed my night at Le Méridien. The location can not be beat and the price per night is a steal in comparison to nearby hotels. The rooms were smaller but efficiently arranged. Large windows allowed lots of light to fill the room. Comfy bed and pillows. Very calming decor palate was perfect for relaxing after a long day. The bar and bartender were great. They have happy hour specials from 4-7. There’s a wonderful courtyard that offers great views and plenty of space. The hotel is very cozy. Dark wood, beautiful stone, and plush seating fill the lobby. The staff were very attentive and happy to help. Room service was good— no hidden fees and reasonable prices. The room was clean and the shower head was spa-level. Will definitely return for my future visits!

name: Lee Brown
text: The hotel and room were gorgeous! The bed was so comfortable that we just sank into it as it cradled us to sleep. And the location is perfect. Close to everything we need. Thank you for an excellent stay!!

name: Nicholas Sharp
text: I truly hope that the general manager of this hotel appreciates his staff. I was having a horrible week and I arrive there and could not have been put in any better spirits. First the bellman John really made me instantly feel welcomed and went above and beyond. And throughout my stay I was reminded of what a pleasure it was walk in through the entrance whenever I saw him. All of the staff at the front desk very warm and friendly and I would even in their most busy times never get anything but their time as if I were the only customer. The rooms in this hotel is spacious and have a wonderful views, and the patio in the fall is truly a gem, and you can see it all the way to the National Cathedral.  I love how close this hotel is to anywhere that I want to go and there’s only a block away from the metro. But I have to say the true pleasure of this hotel was a bellman it really took his time and make me feel special, AB. If you were there in the evening until about 1130 please make sure that you stop in and say hi to this gentleman, his warm welcome and courteous nature are really what every hotel needs.  If you happen to say there and see him please tell him Nicholas said hi, I really cannot thank him enough for taking a stressful situation and turning it into one of the best stays I’ve ever had at a hotel!

name: Amar Bhat
text: We attended a social event at Le Meridien. The venue itself on the fourth floor looks very nice, but it was very warm inside on this hot summer day. The vegetarian food entree was good to me, but many other really did not like their food. There were also some issues setting up the audio visual equipment.

name: Holls
text: I like the mattress, it was nice!! Comfy.

text: Strange set up for a hotel.  Enter the first floor and check in on the fourth.  Once inside the room it was nice.  Hated taking two elevators to the room every time.  Staff was friendly and rooms were clean, just a strange set up for checking in and getting to your room.

text: The bar and lounge on the 4th floor is great.  This is a nice, relaxed off the beaten path spot to enjoy a libation, or conversation or a good view.  Honestly you could even just study here and not buy anything and your privacy would likely be respected by the staff; it is just that kind of place.

name: Richard Abrahamsen
text: Location is close to shops, restaurants, supermarket and public transport. Room was clean, spacious and well appointed. The entrance to the hotel is a little inconvenient as it requires you to take an elevator 4 floors up to get to the main lobby. Staff was iffy. Front desk seemed to be more interested in talking amongst themselve than checking me in. I'd stay here again. Perhaps I caught the staff on an off night.

name: D Phillips
text: Nice and Clean

name: Josh B
text: Don't waste your time. The overpriced, no-frills rooms are outdated, hot,  and have no coffee makers or microwave. Everything in the hotel is overpriced, probably due to their location to Washington and not because they have anything unique to offer. When we asked the front desk if there was onsite laundry service the clerk scoffed and replied "In the year I've worked here, no one has ever asked for laundry service, except for dry cleaning." The only good thing about the hotel was their workout room. I'll be sure to stress to anyone visiting D.C. to choose another hotel.

name: andreana holmes
text: This was my first time staying here and won't be my last! Beautiful room..only reason I didnt give them 5 stars is the pillows..just too soft for me..

name: Nick Morrison
text: Beautiful hotel. Everything we needed was available and close to the metro for quick access to DC

name: Sultan Alsalem
text: Great hotel stuff and helpful. Room is clean and comfortable beds

name: Leonard Jackson
text: Really enjoyed it here. Food Services ... enjoyed it

name: k wads
text: What a great surprise!  They aim to please! It was amazing. We checked in after midnight and they were so helpful and truly accommodating!

name: Rich S
text:
First the room wasn't ready when they said it would be, then they sent me to a room that was of the wrong type and not cleaned since the last guest, then they sent me to a room with a broken HVAC unit. While this was brought to their attention, it was never addressed.

Even if everything had gone well though, I don't see this place having any business calling itself a 4-star hotel. At its best,  it would be along the lines of a standard Hilton Garden Inn.

name: Subir Basak
text: Excellent hotel location in Rosslyn and minutes away from Georgetown. Nice restaurant and gym.

name: Latisha Francis
text: Beautiful building and elegant decor. Friendly and helpful staff. Amazing views

name: Sarah Lee
text:
I stayed at Le Meridien for just one night but I was very impressed with the quality of the hotel. Parking is plentiful in their attached garage and the associate at the front desk was friendly and actually carried on a conversation while he checked us in. He seemed happy to be at work which is rare! Our room was small but comfortable and the bed was very nice. The cleaning staff is top notch because everything was immaculate. Strong water pressure in the sink and shower and general homey feel even though everything is very new.

Constructive criticism for management: rethink the cabinet you have the mini fridge in. It's not made for it and it's apparent.

I would stay here again and I'd recommend to family and friends.

name: Kevin Osborn
text: It's a nice enough Marriot, and I'm a bit ambivalent. I stayed in an accessible room, but the shower totally had problems, When I finally mentioned it, they sent the engineer right away to jury rig it with duck tape. A good result, but really they should have made better choices in the design in the first place. If you are handicapped, the garage is close (no validation) but there are steps to enter the hotel. You can get around this by choosing valet, but really!

name: Nicole Beus Harris
text: Garage situation to the lobby is weird,  but the rooms are nice and the bed was perfect in my opinion.

name: Brianna Murray
text: Got a room last minute through a third party website that guaranteed free parking and WiFi. When I checked in, they said there's a public garage with hourly parking. I reserved a king bed and they only had queens available so offered a room "with a great view." We got to the room and it overlooked the parking garage and building next door. WiFi was only free for rewards members and my Marriott rewards apparently didn't apply. The next morning had very limited coffee and tea options (which was a huge disappointment for an expectant mother sworn off caffeine and desperate for an herbal tea). Told the desk about our frustrations and nothing- no empathy, apologies, or anything. Room was ok but not worth seeking a return trip.

name: Sha'Dawne Dajanee'
text: Gorgeous room. Spacious. My only issue was my sink stopped up a few times and the shower in my room was a little outdated.

name: Dave Miller
text: Always pristine in cleanliness and a  comfortable room.  The location is excellent and so is the staff!

name: Harry
text: Great place to hang out. Love the rooftop vibe

name: Jeffrey Chenault
text: Nice room and great service will be back

name: A. Emy Diop
text: The restaurant inside this hotel! Amazing.. Check out their Sunday brunch.. Lots of options

name: Rev. Christine Mcgunigale
text: What a great place to get married

name: Aaron Marks
text: This is for the restaurant: SLOW, undercooked shrimp, a live bug on my salad.

name: Jermaine J
text: Although it was our second time visiting this hotel my wife and I are always a huge fan of this place.  I don't know why they changed the name from ALoft, however still same great service and staff.  Happy to see they are a SPG member and soon to be part of the Marriott family.

name: Jun Cardenas
text: King size bed was super comfortable.   My wife especially liked the down pillows and the comforter.   It's a bit confusing when you self Park and have to find the elevator to the lobby.

name: Sundar Balusamy
text: Courteous folks. Nice and clean rooms and bath.

name: Kara Gomez
text: Parking is annoying but hotel is nice

name: Erik Jones
text: As long as you can weave your way through the traffic in the other roads leading to this hotel, it is a terrific place to stay. Good reviews, a dedicated parking garage, and very nice restaurants.

name: Eric Imhoff
text: We were there for a friend's wedding the hotel and ceremony were beautiful.

name: Tucker Stapleton
text: Great bartender for mixing drinks, great waiter, all around nice.

name: Andrew Robert
text: They have a good selection at the bar but will be on the pricey side.

name: John Williams
text: This is a Grade B space it is in Crystal City it is well located but it's not the best place to be

name: Alexei Medvedev
text: Good bar, great views, decent burger - will do just fine in a pinch.

name: Louie Sun
text: Modern interior. Nice overlook of Potomac River and Georgetown on 4th floor, but GW parkway is in the foreground. Valet parking $18

name: Jeff K
text: While only 4 floors, they just remodeled. Ultra modern with a great staff

name: Paul Burton
text: Business center is super-helpful if you need to type up and print a document quickly.

name: Amro Kewan
text: Excellent views and my friend got pretty a good rate for the location.

name: Heidi Friedrich
text: Wonderful experience, reception went out of their way to make my experience great.

name: Jeffrey Clayton
text: Nice rooms, great location, and good service.

name: Zach LaScola
text: Nicely appointed rooms and pleasant common areas

name: Josh B.
text: Beautiful hotel with lovely views of Georgetown and clean rooms and walkways.

name: Adriann Dolphin
text: Food was mediocre at best. Soggy calamari, greasy sandwiches. Service was even worse, had to remind the waiter twice of what we ordered. Would not go again.

name: Seth Ganz
text: Beautiful setting, great event. Parking deck triple elevator situation was a little strange.

name: Oscar Roberts
text: I would stay here again if just traveling with my husband or adult friends. Usually for family trips with my kids, I like to book rooms with a fridge and microwave in the room.

name: nathan riech
text:
Wow great hotel! Excellent location, safe and convenient. Walkable to restaurants and parking. Garage next door overnight cost was $15. Check in was fast and covid compliant. Recognized Marriott elite status. Room was a nice size and modern. Updated TV with internet streaming. Internet access was high speed and good for streaming and working. Clean room. Comfortable bed. Quiet hallways.

I've stayed at a number of northern Virginia Marriotts, I think this will be my go to when traveling for work.

name: Elizabeth Hutz
text: Super aesthetic on the inside. The air conditioner in the room is quiet (more of a white noise than a loud rattle like other hotels). Able to totally block out the light from the windows (no middle gap between curtains that can’t quite close). Lots of free parking on the street between 9pm and 8am. I would stay again, and I highly recommend.

name: belinda tillman
text: Very nice hotel with good customer service. Nice rooms

name: Peggy Williams
text: It's a nice hotel, not luxurious but clean and has a great location.

name: Dnshift & Other things!
text: The good ole Old Town Alexandria is an amazing town with so many restaurants and cafe to choose from. This town brings it back from the colonial times. I recommend to visit this place when you get a chance.

name: Araya M
text: Great place to stay. Friendly staff. Very clean and good location.

name: BE Coo
text: Nice hotel to stop and get a good rest. Excellent customer service willing to help you and answer questions that you may have. The entrance is clean and well-kept. Parking may be an obstacle unless you want to pay for valet parking.

name: Chris L.
text: Nice hotel. Most of the staff was nice. The gentlemen that checked us in Thursday was not very informative about the area or anything going on within the hotel. The hotel website states that room service is offered 24/7 but I couldn't find a menu or IR code. Also no information about breakfast offering either. The Trademark restaurant inside of the hotel opens at 11 am most days and closes at 9 pm so I don't believe this is part of their room service/ breakfast options. Also for the Trademark restaurant, their prices are different online that want you'll find in the restaurant. Maybe this changed due to Covid. We had an issue with the drain in our bathroom not working. I contacted the front desk and it was fixed very quickly. The lady I spoke with on Friday was very nice and she was able to give me 2 of the 3 night on my Bonvoy account so I could get the points since I booked the rooms through USAA. Rooms were clean. Complimentary Wi-Fi. If you purchase any drinks from the "gift shop" check the dates. The Gatorade I purchased tasted old. Overall, we will stay here again.

name: Andrew Mercer
text: Friendly staff, clean and updated room, great location close to lots of restaurants. Resulted in a great experience for our company's conference.

name: Jonathan Shaw
text: Beautiful facility with professional, friendly staff, and in a great location too. Definitely coming back!

name: Mohammad Elahinia
text: This Westin has a very attractive wooden clock installation right in the middle of the lobby. If you visit, I suggest taking a good look and trying to figure out the mechanism. The rooms were of course very clean and quiet. The option to not have housekeeping was offered as a conservation measure. The food served at our workshop was very good quality and healthy.

name: LANCE SAUNDERS
text: This is a great location in Alexandria. The hotel and rooms are very nice, clean, and comfortable. It like it shows on the website. The breakfast was disappointing. Not much variety and did not live up to what we expected for Westin. We also fined for dinner. Same disappointment. After first morning, we chose to eat out for breakfast. We would recommend the same.

name: Brian Smith
text: I love it here.  Fancy rooms, big TVs and robes!

name: Anne Parris
text:
Great location, excellent staff, comfortable and clean rooms. If you come in from the metro or the Amtrak station, use the hotel's free shuttle.
Great place for an event.
Plenty of good places to eat within walking distance, but the hotel restaurant-bar was excellent for snacks, drinks, and brunch.

name: Toni Airaksinen
text:
I’ve been to a few Westin’s and this was definitely the best that I’ve visited. The rooms are spacious, the room service is fast, and overall it’s a really comfortable experience.

It’s not super instagramable, but the lobby is neatly organized. I didn’t visit the restaurant/ hotel attached to the bar, but I did go to the Thai restaurant across the street, which was delicious and very reasonable for the money.

Overall, definitely it was great! I’d definitely stay again!

name: Lawrence Taub
text: Nice hotel. Not too far from the airport. Friendly staff. Rooms are a good size and everything looks classy and well kept. They've got a nice lobby with a bar/restaurant off of it. Elevators were fast and the hotel was pretty quiet at night.

name: Taina Ramirez
text: My stay was excellent.  Beautiful, upscale hotel and very modern.  However, there's no public parking.  Only valet parking for $32 a night.

name: Faris Fink
text: Nice place. Kind of out of the way but I liked it. Staff was amazing very kind.

name: D Mason
text: Great hotel and location. The staff is very friendly and informative. Love going to this hotel

name: Bobby G

text: A very nice experience checking in...A robot could have done better! Room's view was horrible (facing other buildings). Parking slightly on the expensive side. The brunch for the weekend is on the expensive side as well. The reason I am giving Westin hotel four stars is because it is clean.

text: Very well run hotel. Professional and extremely helpful staff. Decent restaurant. Food from kitchen was fresher than most hotels.  Rooms are clean and fresh.  The shower does not work properly though

Room was very clean and all the features worked in the room. Room Service was fast and good. A bit pricey but it is room service. The bed was very comfortable and the there was a very large new TV in the room with on demand.

name: Katherine Kaplan
text: Have made regular reservations here for the past year. The rooms are large and clean, the hand held shower and tub combination is great with strong and hot water, the beds and pillows are comfortable and the staff is wonderful. They now provided access to Netflix, YouTube and a few other popular apps on the TV, just need to login with your account information.

name: Katlin Barrett
text: A very upbeat and busy hotel with great service and clean rooms.

name: nourddine ezzaroualy
text: Great reception and good service for a wonderful business visitor

name: Laura Watson
text: Enjoyed my stay here, it's a very new and clean. Bathroom excellent, closet roomy, bed very very comfortable, curtains easy to operate and high quality. Like the bonus points for declining maid service. And thank you Westin for always having coffee makers! It's amazing that some of the high end chains think coffee should only be ordered with room service, shame on them.

name: Amina Vohra
text: Love this hotel, front desk staff, restaurant staff and cleaning staff. Well circulated rooms and conference rooms which isnt easy to find. Very nice and clean rooms. Highly recommend.

name: Michael Humphrey
text: I visited  the bar/restaurant, the trademark bar. They have excellent staff that is quick prompt and always engage a patron. They give good suggestions for drinks and food. The food is always well executed and tasty. The same applies to drinks. Bar makes in house syrups for original drinks. I had wings and Mac and cheese. Mac was in a chance style with deep fried  pickles and ham on side. Had a drunken monk drink. Gin drink with rosemary thyme syrup. I enjoyed my meal. It was expensive meal but not overpriced.

name: rvagourmet
text: Great location, valet service was very quick.  What you would expect from a Westin.  Only a quick ride into the district as well.

name: Bobby Scott
text: Very pretty hotel, was attending a wedding vendor showcase there for the city of Alexandria. Location is nice, and the overall look and feel of the hotel was pretty as well. Restroom is on 2nd floor, which was a little inconvenient but not awful. Valet parking was $10, also less expensive than most hotels I've visited. Would come check this place out as a guest in the future.

name: Paul Eldridge
text: Lovely wooden moving sculpture in the lobby! I always have a restful awesome time whenever staying at Westin hotels, their beds seem to be the only hotel beds that consistently leave me energized and ready for the day on business trips. Valet parking is like $35 though, and the only hotel parking they have, so try to find street parking if you can.

name: David Mathews
text: Over sold the king rooms, so my wife and I spent our "romantic" weekend in separate beds.  Catering for our group was high quality and surprisingly good. However, they didn't serve enough for our whole group to eat. Spent a lot of time waiting for more food to arrive. Hotel was very clean and well-decorated.

name: Jeff Seibel
text: Had dinner for a professional event. Very well put together and the steak was delicious. Did not stay overnight but this is AAA four star Hotel.

name: Sharon Robinson
text: WOW! Great first impression. Had a company event and booked a room to complete the experience. Rate wasn't any higher than lower star chains we've stayed at. Could notice a difference, starting with the front desk staff. Coincidence? I don't know, but I liked it and I took note. Entire hotel and our room was Great! Largest flat screen TV we've ever had in a room. 50 Inches, I think. We may have to look at Westin's again and hope the rates are good. Thanks!

name: Hamza Fiyarhi I حمزة فياغي
text: I work here actually and i see the details and i can tell this is a great place to spend night .😊👪👫

name: Keva P
text:
The hotel is conveniently located in downtown Alexandria. The rooms are spacious and the common areas are clean even when big events are scheduled.
There are inexpensive parking garages nearby. The hotel parking valet is expensive.

name: Tammy Smith
text: Highly recommend this lovely hotel. The decor is tasteful & on the elegant side. The bedding was so comfortable & luxurious. The on-site restaurant was ridiculously priced. Breakfast buffet, $25 pp. Wi-fi is $15, but free on the first floor. The only thing that was so extremely dumb...Parking, $36 for 24 hours. Really??? To charge a paying guest that much for parking? Ridiculous. As you enter the premises...to the right...there is a parking garage that charges $8. A 3-5 minute walk. Highly recommend this beautiful hotel. Just don’t eat or park there. Oh...got this place for $88 on Priceline.

name: Yvette Spivock
text: Large rooms. Great bathroom. Very clean. helpful and kind staff. Easy access to free trolley to Waterfront and also about a 20-minute walk

name: Adam L
text:
I've stayed here ~35 nights over the past 18 months, so I have a wealth of experience at this location.  Avoid this hotel if possible.
Rooms:  Furnishings are normal for a Westin, but there is a surprising amount of room noise.  From your bed, you can hear the sounds of pigeons and other guests' bathroom activities and conversations through the vents.
Cleanliness:  Bathroom towels/cloths frequently go unchanged.  Have found clothing items belonging to previous guests in my own room after checking in.
Parking:  This is abysmal.  The facility has a very small parking area, and few valets to service it.  I have waited over 40 minutes for my car in the morning.  If you call down to request your car and then head downstairs 10m later, the valets frequently are not aware of your request; you must ask them personally, at which point they fetch the vehicle.
Executive Lounge:  Poorly stocked, and the smell of cigarette smoke is often profound.
Restroom:  Shower water temperatures vary more than normal due to water usage of other guests.  Higher floors experience this to a greater degree than lower floors.

If you must stay at a Westin in this area, drive a few miles East and stay at National Harbor.

name: eme ndukwe
text: Nice and peacefull

name: Louie Sun
text: Attended a wedding here. Luxurious feel with updated/modern design. Service and food were both very good. Friendly staff and location is close to highways

name: Ben Zahn
text: Tasteful renovations accented excellent customer service. The in-house bar/restaurant served unique food items and top-notch local libations. Overall an exceptional stay!

name: Kristin Bass
text: Comfortable rooms and nice conference facilities. The hotel is within walking distance of lots of casual spots for lunch.

name: Clarence Whitley
text: Nice clean establishment with healthy options, housekeeping could have been better

name: Kevin Mahaffey
text: Location is good, busy but not downtown DC busy. Several restaurants within walking. Hotel is nice but they lose a star in my opinion due to service or lack of. Simple internet problem, it was my mistake, but could have easily been confirmed by phone at front desk if they had taken the time to listen to the issue. Instead they transfer me to an internet help desk where I waited for several minutes to get a very simple fix.

name: Star Picucci
text: We used the Westin as our guest accommodations and getting ready spot.  Our corner suite was great and the location can't be beat for a wedding at Carlyle Club.  The staff is attentive and the attached bar/restaurant is quite good.  Be sure you realize that parking is a minimum of $35/day and there is no longer a pool.

name: Guillermo Zamudio
text: Great stay !

name: Matt Karas
text: The wooden pendulum in the lobby is very cool. Staff were nice. Shower was great.

name: Amanda Cassa
text: The hotel was beautiful. The service was very nice. The ballroom was lovely and the DJ and dance crew was awesome.and accommodating. I enjoyed my time there and it was spacious even with having a full room.

name: Devon Terrell
text: The hotel was very clean and looked nice. Great rainfall shower head, spacious rooms, good service. Breakfast was not included, but offered a buffet for $20 that was very nice. Several cheaper breakfast alternatives are easily in walking distance. Only thing that irked me was the lack of complementary WiFi.

name: Gene King
text: Over priced for what you get.  Won't be back, for $300 a night expect much cleaner and better amenities.

name: Marina Khoury
text: Clean, updated rooms with service from staff to GM impeccable!! Looking forward to our next stay!

name: Jitin Krishnan
text: The overall experience and service was nice. The staff provided us with a microwave at request. Apart from the minor issues with the direct TV everything was good.

name: Matthew Miller
text: Great Location and Service, metro into DC or Uber was less than 20 minute ride either way.

name: Melissa Parlor
text: Nice hotel. They have a restaurant and a Starbucks in the hotel. The handmade wood clock is beautiful.

name: Allison Swift
text:
We were about an hour early for check in, but our room was already prepared and was hypoallergenic as requested. Check in was fast and easy.
The room was very large and well decorated and furnished. In addition to a king size bed with an upholstered bench there was a seating area with two chairs, ottoman, and a table. The room had a minibar and complimentary coffee station. The blinds made it feel private even though it was filtering through enough light. We had no problem with hearing any noises from adjacent rooms.
I love that the shower had a double shower head. The water pressure was great, and the bathroom was very clean.
We had no issues with any of the mechanics of the room and the climate control worked without any hassle.
We visited the indoor pool and hot tub shortly after checking in, and were lucky to have it to ourselves. The pool area has plenty of seating and places to put your things while you swim. The pool was well kept. It was a little on the small side and one depth, but that wasn't a problem for us.
Though the hotel is a little off the beaten path, we used the complimentary shuttle service which runs until 10PM to take us down to Old Town. The driver was very nice and got us right to the doorstep of our destination.
The only issue that came up during our stay was we were charged $1.50 for a phone call that we made to the concierge to arrange to take the shuttle but that was rectified at check out.
Would certainly recommend and stay again.

name: Matthew Zumbar
text: My wife and one of my daughters went to visit my mother who lives above the Westin. We decided to eat at the restaurant in the Westin because it was so cold. The employees were all very nice and like usual the restaurant was great.

name: Imran Z
text: Good staff, nice room and shower

text: This Westin is Fantastic!! Lovely Lobby and Rooms, the Employees are Always Nearby and Helpful!! You Can Walk to Old Town and Take in the Restaurants and Shops!! Will Return In the Very Near Future!!

name: Michael Lane
text: Attended a conference here. Public spaces and conference facilities very nice, banquet food very acceptable.

name: Daniel Boyd
text: I do a big corporate event here every year. Itbisnjice, and so are the staff. It has a distinctive smell, though, and I have come to loathe it, as it represents stress and work. Do what you will with that information.

name: Angélica Garcia
text: Clean and bright, well-maintained facilities. The service staff can be a bit slow out of the gate, but they're friendly and helpful. The rooms are nice, bright and well decorated. The restaurant is a bit hit or miss but having the bar onsite is convenient. The front desk will tell you that there is a Starbucks 'on-site' but it's actually around the corner on the same block and doesn't open until 7am on the weekends, I'm not sure what time it opens during the week. The breakfast was underwhelming and overpriced. Considering there are plenty of other options in the area, it might be worth exploring a different spot to dine in the morning. Overall it was a pleasant stay.

name: N Hinton
text: No free WiFi. Hidden fees and charges everywhere if your not careful and read the fine print. Even the "free" breakfast isn't free. If you stay here be very careful and watch for hidden charges. Did not like the valet. They were pushy and rude and stared at me like I was an alien when I asked questions about my car and its location. $34 a night to park at the hotel as a guest.....absurd. Front desk clerk was okay...at least he was not rude. Would not be my first choice to stay here again for future trips. Very disappointed.

Also, the Starbucks was not open early on Sunday and the Assistant Manager immediately suggested another one a few blocks away.  That one was closed also.  Not a big deal, but I assumed the other Starbucks would be open if he in fact had suggested it.  I guess he did not want to interrupt his personal conversation with the cab drivers.

text:
Very impressed with their level of cleanliness and attention to detail. Their studio suites are well designed, have plenty of space to move around, and get tons of natural light. I had a couple of last-minute requests at check-in and Carol at the front desk managed to accommodate both of them! Definitely was a nice touch. A big thank you to Carol and the rest of the staff for a great stay.

Housekeeping and front desk staff excellent, courteous, and very helpful. Laundry room is clean and machines are in good working order. A note for anyone wanting to use the laundry -- top-loading machines do not use fresh water to rinse your clothes -- they do not refill for the 'rinse' cycle, but just swish your clothes around more in the same dirty, soapy water from the wash. Then the machine drains and spins and is done. They seem to be programmed this way, as other machines by this brand (Speed Queen) usually do rinse.  For anyone who is allergic to soap residue on their skin or clothes (like me), or just anyone who wants their clothes non-dirty and non-soapy, you will need to put your clothes through again (and use extra quarters and spend extra time) to get clothes rinsed. Super easy fix to put them through again for a rinse if you're aware of this, but it would definitely be good to know in advance that machines don't rinse automatically, it requires extra $$ and time.
Overall, this hotel seems to keep to  high standards for their rooms and staff. Thank you for providing a great stay! :)

text: I really like this TRH. The staff are always professional and friendly and make sure you're taken care of. The food is almost always delicious (every place has an off day) and they do a great job cooking their steaks to order.  They practice good social distancing and all staff wear masks. The seating is spaced apart comfortably, and there weren't any crowds in the waiting area. They ask you to wait in your car and send you text notifications about being seated.  Our waitress Katie was great and made sure we always had full drinks and a supply of those delicious rolls. The food came out in a timely manner and everyone enjoyed thier meal. Overall a really nice experience considering the current climate.

name: Guess who
text:
The Charlottesville Texas Roadhouse location used to be excellent. However, with a change in management, the service and cooking made a turn for the worse, making this location quite subpar.

Most of the waitresses and waiters are very nice, professional, and attentive. On occasion you will find an employee who neglects the customers or is not personable, or both.

The food is good when the cooks don't over-season it with salt and pepper. During a recent visit the corn had so much pepper it could not be eaten. Also, the steaks were ruined by an excessive amount of seasoning salt applied when cooking.

The meats are usually cooked as ordered,  however, lately over-done or burned meat has become more common. An incident of under-done meat has not been experienced.

The portion of house salad has been ridiculously small at times, being 4 to 5 average size bites.

There is no consistency with the amount of sugar in the sweetened tea. Sometimes it will taste unsweetened. Other times it will taste like pure sugar. Rarely will it be a well balanced mix.

The delicious rolls Texas Roadhouse is known for have become ridiculously small, at little over an inch (see picture).  Also, the rolls are many times dense, thus being tough and chewey.

You will often find 3 to 5 employees hanging around the register where the phone is located. This phone will ring endlessly while being ignored by these employees as they socialize and mess about on their cell phones. Thus, if you try to call the restaurant in regards to an order or booking a party, you may have a difficult time getting an answer.

The To-Go service is poor. The To-Go orders are wrong or incomplete near 100% of the time. Be sure, if you order Take-Out, that you check your order for accuracy before leaving the restaurant.

name: Mili Steele-Hollenbeck
text: We had dinner there last night (4/2/21). After we sat down, we watched the busboy rush through clearing a table and barely have time to wave the cloth over the table before the hostess was there with another group. There were still bits of food on the table. Then there was a hostess with long sandy hair that had her mask below her nose the whole night. I tried to motion to her to move it up as she went by but was ignored. And there were multiple customers running around with no mask at all and nothing was said to them. We won't be going back since the steak DEFINITIVELY is not to die for.

name: Bryan Timberlake
text:
Texas Roadhouse is the only non fast food chain restaurant that hasn’t disappointed me where most big chains now days push me towards local places.

I’ve experienced a few minor issues at Roadhouse but nothing big enough to make me not want to come back. The minor issues were simply some cold food and one time a year or two ago I had a waitress who just seemed to be obliviously distracted by something else. All the other servers I remember having have been phenomenal! Especially then female ones seem to be very upbeat, attentive and friendly.

It’s not uncommon to see this place busy on a weeknight so I recommend downloading the app to get added to the wait list especially with reduced seating capacity right now. You can also view the menu, order food to go through the app and see locations.

The food is great and a lot of the meals come with two sides plus some of them cost less if you come in before 6:00pm Monday-Thursday. Pro tip: if you get your mashed potatoes loaded then ask for the toppings on the side as they can cool down the potatoes quicker if they’re added on in the kitchen.

Great food and great service keep me coming back. The only downside is I work nearby so I wish that they were opened before 4:00pm every day instead of just Friday-Saturday in case I ever wanted to get lunch to go. And I’m not 100% sure how the VIP program works. Regardless, I’m glad Texas Roadhouse decided to open a location in Charlottesville!

I'm also disappointed they don't have a dedicated gf menu to avoid the health issues like the time they brought me a dish saying it was newly made gf, and 2 minutes later telling me not to eat it... text:
I don't normally review chains since it doesn't really matter what a review says to a chain restaurant, but this meal deserves some feedback.

I took my parents here the day before Mother's Day and was greeted, waited, and seated like normal. On the way to the table, the hostess said we were lucky because we had the best server in the restaurant, Eddie.

When Eddie greeted us, we playfully warned him of the high expectations that were set. I hope the hostess was kidding, because Eddie was a total letdown. He spent his entire time flirting with a table next to us and barely paid any attention to us. It was clear what "tip" he was working on.

What saved this meal was how friendly the rest of the staff was and the amazing bone-in ribeye I received. It could honestly have been the best steak I've had at a restaurant for under $50. I would call it a perfect chain restaurant steak. Zero complaints from me on the steak -- and I'm a steak snob.

TL;DR - get the bone-in ribeye and avoid sitting in Eddie's section.
