text:
If there's one restaurant I can ALWAYS count on it's Texas Roadhouse. I have lived in 7 cities and have never  had bad service there. When w got one 20 min closer to home in Charlottesville I was ecstatic.

What a letdown! Texas Roadhouse - Charlottesville, you should be ashamed to carry the holy name of the steak gods. Please fix it! 3x now we have had atrocious service and I have heard many stories from others. I won't hold this against TRH as a whole but I don't think I'll be going back to the Charlottesville location. I'll take the ride to Texas Roadhouse - Richmond (Glen Allen).

Last night we had a total of four rolls for 6 guests over an hour at the table (asked for more several times). The food we received was great and timely except one steak which was extremely overcooked. Took the waitress the time it took everyone else to eat their plate to check and see if the food was ok. No problem, we'll cook you another and have a manager bring it out. Manager comes out with WRING CUT OF STEAK. Goes back comes out with right steak. Time to leave, put in box. Get checks, no discount no nothing. Ask server "no discount because you're taking it home". Excuse me? When has this been the norm? Also, checks were not right, 2/3 were wrong items listed.

Not what I expect at all when visiting my favorite chain restaurant, Texas Roadhouse.

name: Jeannie Armstrong
text:
*This doesn't even deserve a 1 star.*
I do understand the stress of Fathers Day working at a restaurant, I've been there & done that.  But the treatment that was received here was severely under par, so much so that it was, abuse.
1st off, after waiting 30 minutes to be seated, we were seated in the bar (alcohol) area without being asked if it was OK, since we had a child with us. This is just plain wrong in so many ways, but I don't have the time (or space) to go into right now.
2nd, ordered a chopped steak (hamburger) with grilled onions & mushrooms, no cheese. I must point out that at no time was I ever asked how I wanted this cooked, and I did not think it strange to not be asked as it is GROUND BEEF, and is to be cooked thoroughly, period.
But when the order was received, it was only cooked on the outside, and pink on the inside.  It all went downhill from there. We tried to tell the waitress that brought it to us (not our waiter) that it wasn't cooked, but in the middle of me saing this, she interupted me and asked, "is it not cooked like you ordered it? So I tried to explain that I wasn't asked how I wanted it cooked, just to be interrupted again by her saying 'I'll go have them fix it again.. well, then I thought maybe I'll just order something that may be easier for them to fix, so I asked to just change it to the beef tips, but no gravy, only the onions & mushrooms. She said that she would put the order in, and let our waiter know.
Two minutes later our waiter finely comes by and asks if everything was OK, so I start to explain things to him hoping for a great dinner and not so stressful on them. But, I got mmediently interrupted by some dude with a nose ring coming up on the other side of me asking me point blank 'what temperature do you want your meat?', I looked at him and asked, temperature of what? And he repeated himself again. I just looked him straight in the eye and told him that I wanted it cooked, but not burnt plain and simple. So he's like, so medium, medium well, what? Again, I'm just beside myself as this is just abuse as far as I'm concerned about now. So I tell him medium well. He finely leaves. Then, this person whom I assume is/was the manager/assistant manager brings this plate to me and litterly demands that 'I' check to see if it was cooked right. So I cut into two pieces and they are fine. So she's like 'OK fine', and I'm like no not fine, I asked for no gravy...  So she's like, I'll go have them fix it right. And I'm like NO, we're going to forget this. By this time it's been 30+ minutes, everyone else has eaten, Ive had enough of this unimaginable crap as I can take.
Yes, it is/was a busy day for everyone.
Yes, everyone has a bad day once in a while.
Yes, everyone deserves to be cut slack.
But customers deserve proper service, good properly cooked food, without attitude, bullying, hate, and abuse.
I will not be going back.

The moral of my story is you never know who is watching you especially in a restaurant.

name: Yolanda Walkling
text: I ordered a cake for my daughter’s Birthday yesterday morning and told the lady what I wanted. She took my name and said I will see you soon. The cake was to be ready by 3pm. I had a major delay in plans as family was coming from out of town and I called and told them I was running late and a man in the bakery told me not to worry that the cake would be in the cooler and just go to customer service if no one was there. Well we get to Martins and NO ONE can find the cake. Manager said are you sure it was this store? Huh? I called the same number I had called 3 times before earlier in the day. That is how I got ahold of him. Ok so the manager offers us a different cake and writes on it HAPPY 24th Birthday ELISABETH. And hands me a horse cake topper kit that has absolutely nothing themed in the cake.  We were in a hurry because the whole- lost-cake ordeal put us behind even further. I ended up not putting the kit one because it looked stupid not having the original background it was supposed to. Then when my daughter and sisters see the name on the Cake they bust out laughing. My daughter’s name is ELIZABETH, Not Elisabeth.  So I looked dumb. Then as we were cutting the cake the icing was running and water was pooling the the moat around the cake apparently because the cake sweated or was frozen before. It was kind of disgusting. I will never order another cake from them. I have pictures of all of it and I am embarrassed that’s they couldn’t get the cake right both times

Came in on a Tuesday evening near Virginia curfew time. Was on my way to work and needed a little evening pick me up. Their menu screens were on the fritz so couldn't see any prices. I did see a sign for 20 piece combo and since I needed something quick and easy, the McNuggets were it. They made the nuggets fresh as well as the fries.

There is something special about freshly made food. Perfectly salted and to wash it down with sweet tea.

What can I say? I'm a simple dude with simple tastes. Sometimes you just need a 20 piece nuggets, fries, and sweet tea to make you feel like the king of the world.

With his help I was able to reconcile my billing problems and get great advice for handling the next steps. Couldn't have gotten better or more friendly service.  Many thanks.
